column1: Artillery and air strikes reduce enemy entrenchment values by 1 point per attack.
column2: 炮击与空袭每次可使敌方工事值降低 1 点。

column1: Don't attack well-entrenched infantry units in city hexes with your tanks.
column2: 不要用坦克攻击城市格中工事坚固的步兵。

column1: Drop your air mobile units deep behind enemy lines to take victory objectives.
column2: 将空中机动部队投送至敌后纵深，夺取胜利目标。

column1: Engage enemy armor with anti-tank units from a distance.
column2: 用反坦克单位在远距离对付敌方装甲。

column1: Focus on taking victory hexes, not just killing enemy units.
column2: 着眼于夺取胜利格，而非仅仅歼灭敌军。

column1: In a campaign, you can 'over-strength' your units between scenarios to increase their effectiveness.
column2: 在战役中，你可以在场景之间超编部队，以提升其战力。

column1: Infantry is best at attacking and defending from towns, forests, and mountains.
column2: 步兵在城市、森林与山地攻防最佳。

column1: Keep your artillery close enough to the front lines to support your troops.
column2: 让炮兵靠前到足以支援前线部队。

column1: Kill off a wounded enemy unit before it gets the chance to reinforce again.
column2: 在受损敌军获得补充之前将其歼灭。

column1: Move a unit adjacent to the enemy to fully spot them.
column2: 将部队移动到敌军相邻格，以完全侦察其动向。

column1: Never leave light infantry out in open and clear terrain.
column2: 切勿让轻步兵暴露在开阔地形中。

column1: Partially spotted units have better defense than spotted units.
column2: 部分被侦察的部队，防御优于完全暴露的部队。

column1: Plane movement is halted if moved within range of a hidden Air Defense unit capable of engaging it.
column2: 飞机进入可对其开火的隐蔽防空单位射程内时，其移动将中止。

column1: Recon units are easily spotted, but they screen your other nearby units.
column2: 侦察单位容易被发现，但能掩护附近的友军。

column1: Recon units can stagger their movement into separate stages.
column2: 侦察单位可将移动分为多个阶段。

column1: When you requisition new units, don't forget to add Attachments.
column2: 征募新部队时，别忘了添加附属编制。

column1: A barely acceptable performance, Herr General.  Only the brilliant maneuvers of Fieldmarschall Rommel saved the situation.  He will now continue with the conquest of Egypt and the Suez Kanal. You and your men are to be transferred back to the Russian front, where things have not gone well. Fieldmarschall Paulus has been unable to break out of Stalingrad.  Worse, intelligence indicates that the Bolsheviks are planning a great offensive in the Kursk region.  The General Staff hopes that your failure at El Alamein was but a temporary departure from your previous excellent conduct and thus is giving you one more chance to prove yourself.
column2: 勉强可以接受的表现，将军阁下。全靠隆美尔元帅的卓越机动才挽回了局势。他将继续征服埃及和苏伊士运河。您和您的部下将被调回俄国前线，那里的情况不太顺利。保卢斯元帅未能从斯大林格勒突围。更糟的是，情报显示布尔什维克正计划在库尔斯克地区发动一场大规模攻势。总参谋部希望您在阿拉曼的失利只是暂时偏离了您以往出色的表现，因此再给您一次证明自己的机会。

column1: A glorious victory, Herr Feldmarschall!  The Bolsheviks have surrendered unconditionally!  We will require the independence of Bylorussia and the Ukraine under German protection, which will stabilize our Eastern borders.  We are about to sign a peace treaty with the English and Americans which will involve our withdrawal from England and France (we keep Alsace-Lorraine).  Now we will have the peace necessary to develop the Fatherland to its full potential.
column2: 光荣的胜利，元帅阁下！布尔什维克已无条件投降！我们将要求白俄罗斯和乌克兰在德国保护下独立，这将稳定我们的东部边界。我们即将与英国人和美国人签署和约，内容包括我们从英格兰和法国撤军（我们保留阿尔萨斯-洛林）。现在我们将获得必要的和平，来充分开发祖国的全部潜力。

column1: A major problem was the rough terrain, but you have established excellent positions near the Nalon river.  The Reds quarters at both Simancas and Zapadores have fallen and we are now at the gates of Oviedo.  We must press on to save our brave fellows from the Red onslaught and show the world that we are not going to surrender without a fight.
column2: 崎岖地形曾是个大问题，但你已在纳隆河附近建立了极佳的阵地。赤色分子在锡曼卡斯和萨帕多雷斯的营地均已陷落，我们现在已兵临奥维耶多城下。我们必须继续推进，把勇敢的弟兄们从赤色分子的猛攻中解救出来，并向世界表明我们不会不战而降。

column1: After much ebb and flow, the African front has stabilized at Gazala. It is time for you to seize the initiative and drive the British out of Libya and Egypt. Your goal is to seize Cairo and all other objectives by September 30th. However, given the entry of the Americans in the war, it may be necessary to complete the conquest of Egypt earlier to prevent an American invasion of Northwest Africa.
column2: 经过反复拉锯，非洲前线已在加扎拉稳定下来。现在该由你夺取先手，将英军逐出利比亚和埃及。你的目标是在9月30日前夺取开罗及所有其他目标。但鉴于美国已参战，为阻止美军入侵西北非，可能有必要提前完成对埃及的征服。

column1: Ah, Good day, Herr General!  Please sit down  and allow me to explain the present situation.  The Spanish Nationalists have requested the help of Germany to wrest control of Spain from their enemies. In leading this expedition, you will have the opportunity to sharpen your skills in the art of war. You will test the General Staff's new ideas regarding tank use, concentration of force, and combined arms operations.  Your expertise can then be put to work towards the real objective:  the return of Germany to its proper place,  the leader of Europe.
column2: 啊，你好，将军阁下！请坐，容我说明当前局势。西班牙国民军已请求德国出手，帮助他们从敌人手中夺回西班牙的控制权。率领这支远征军，你将有机会磨炼自己的战争技艺。你将检验总参谋部关于坦克运用、集中兵力和合成兵种作战的新构想。此后，你的专长便可投入到真正的目标上：让德国恢复其应有的地位，成为欧洲的领袖。

column1: Ah, Herr General, I hope you have enjoyed your leave.  As you know, British and Commonwealth  troops have occupied the historic pass at Thermopylae.  You must secure this pass and prevent the escape of the enemy.  The terrain is rugged and difficult for maneuver.   You must act decisively. These troops were bypassed in our initial Grecian campaign, but now is the time to eliminate this threat to our control of the area.
column2: 啊，将军阁下，希望您休假愉快。如您所知，英国和英联邦军队已占领了温泉关这一历史名隘。您必须夺取该隘口，阻止敌人逃脱。当地地形崎岖，难以机动。您必须果断行动。这些部队在我军最初的希腊战役中被绕过了，现在是消除他们对本地区控制权威胁的时候了。

column1: Ah, Herr General, I hope you have enjoyed your leave.  As you know, the British fortress of Gibraltar is a serious threat to our operations in the Mediterranean region.  With the conquest of France, and your victory in Norway, now is the time to eliminate this threat to our control of the Mediterranean.  We have persuaded Spain to join us and our ally Italy in our attack on Gibraltar.
column2: 啊，将军阁下，希望您休假愉快。如您所知，英国人的直布罗陀要塞对我们在地中海地区的作战构成严重威胁。随着法国被征服，加上您在挪威的胜利，现在是消除这一对我们地中海控制权威胁的时候了。我们已说服西班牙加入我们和我们的盟友意大利，共同进攻直布罗陀。

column1: Ah, Herr General.  Excuse me, Herr Feldmarschall.  A bold stroke to invade England is necessary.  We must force the Allies to the bargaining table so that we may have the peace needed to develop the Fatherland to its full glory.  You have been given command of the initial phase of the invasion.
column2: 啊，将军阁下。失敬，是元帅阁下。对英格兰发动一次大胆入侵势在必行。我们必须迫使盟军回到谈判桌前，以便获得让祖国充分发展其全部荣光所需的和平。您已被授予此次入侵第一阶段行动的指挥权。

column1: Ah, Herr General.  Excuse me, Herr Feldmarschall.  A bold stroke to invade England is necessary.  We must force the Allies to the bargaining table so we may have the peace needed to develop the Fatherland to its full glory.  You have been given command of one section of the invasion.
column2: 啊，将军阁下。失敬，是元帅阁下。对英格兰发动一次大胆入侵势在必行。我们必须迫使盟军回到谈判桌前，以便获得让祖国充分发展其全部荣光所需的和平。您已被授予此次入侵一个方向上的指挥权。

column1: All that stands between us and victory in the west is a quick knock-out blow against the disorganized allied armies in France. Your mission is to break the French 'will to resist' by taking Paris and all other objectives by no later than July 30th. However, due to the difficulties involved in preparing for an invasion of England, it is essential that you end this campaign much sooner if at all possible. Otherwise, the opportunity to invade England this summer will be lost. The upcoming battle for France is the most important campaign you have yet to participate in.
column2: 挡在我们与西线胜利之间的，只有一件事：迅速给法国境内混乱的盟军部队一记致命打击。你的任务是在7月30日之前夺取巴黎及所有其他目标，从而摧毁法国人的抵抗意志。但鉴于入侵英国的战备工作困难重重，你务必尽可能大幅提前结束本战役。否则，今夏入侵英国的机会将会丧失。即将开始的法国战役，是你迄今参与过的最重要的战役。

column1: All the main ports of the Mediterranean Sea are now under our control! Only the Suez Canal remains under British domination... We shall see how many time they can use the Canal!
column2: 地中海所有主要港口现在都在我们控制之下！只有苏伊士运河仍在英国统治下……我们倒要看看他们还能使用运河多久！

column1: Although you were able to capture Stalingrad, the Soviet winter offensives have forced us back along the entire front.
column2: 尽管你得以攻克斯大林格勒，但苏联人的冬季攻势已迫使我们在整条战线上后退。

column1: Although you were able to take all of your objectives, and successfully fight off the Russian counterattack, unfortunately we lost the initiative on the eastern front, and must prepare to fight off the inevitable Soviet offensives that are coming.
column2: 尽管你成功夺取了全部目标，并击退了苏军的反攻，但遗憾的是，我们在东线失去了先手，必须准备迎击即将到来、不可避免的苏军攻势。

column1: Although you were successful in taking Cairo, we must now move some of our assets in order to strengthen our hold on Northwest Africa.
column2: 尽管你成功夺取了开罗，我们现在仍必须抽调部分兵力，以加强我们对西北非的控制。

column1: Although you were unable to expel the invaders, your defense of Germany was sufficiently resolute to persuade the allies to grant us an armistice, similar to the unpopular one signed in 1918.
column2: 虽然你未能将入侵者逐出，但你对德国的防御足够坚决，使盟军同意给予我们停战，其性质类似 1918年签订的那份不受欢迎的停战协定。

column1: Although you were unable to take all of your objectives, you did successfully fight off the Russian counterattack. Unfortunately we lost the initiative on the eastern front, and another year of senseless fighting in Russia has come and gone.
column2: 尽管你未能夺取全部目标，但你成功击退了苏军的反攻。遗憾的是，我们在东线失去了先手，俄国战场上又一年无谓的厮杀就此过去。

column1: Although you were unable to take all of your objectives, you did successfully fight off the Russian counterattack. Unfortunately we lost the initiative on the eastern front, and must now prepare to fight off the inevitable Soviet offensives that are coming.
column2: 尽管你未能夺取全部目标，但你成功击退了苏军的反攻。遗憾的是，我们在东线失去了先手，现在必须准备迎击即将到来、不可避免的苏军攻势。

column1: Although your objectives were taken, RAF squadrons that arrived on Malta during the last half of June have prevented an advance on Cairo.
column2: 尽管各项目标均已夺取，但6月下半月抵达马耳他的皇家空军中队阻止了我军向开罗推进。

column1: An exceptional victory at Stalingrad, but unfortunately, the Soviet winter offensives have forced us back along the entire front, putting us in an extremely difficult position. We must now plan accordingly.
column2: 斯大林格勒一役取得了非凡的胜利，但遗憾的是，苏联人的冬季攻势已迫使我们在整条战线上后退，使我方陷入极为困难的境地。我们现在必须据此重新筹划。

column1: An exceptional victory in the Caucasus, but unfortunately, the Soviet winter offensives have forced us back along the entire front, putting us in an extremely difficult position. We must now plan accordingly.
column2: 高加索之战是一次非凡的胜利，但不幸的是，苏军的冬季攻势已迫使我们在全线后退，使我们陷入极其困难的处境。我们现在必须相应调整计划。
澳大利亚攻略战 - 阿德莱德
澳大利亚攻略战 - 达尔文
巴巴罗萨 (布列斯特-立托夫斯克)

column1: BREAKING NEWS:  While flying to a meeting with Generalisimo Franco General Mola’s plane crashed near Burgos.  There were no survivors.
column2: 突发新闻：在飞往与佛朗哥大元帅会晤的途中，莫拉将军的座机在布尔戈斯附近坠毁。无人生还。

column1: Brilliant work. You have fulfilled the General Staff's hopes!  Your drive to Avranches has forced the last of the American and British forces from Europe.  Now we can concentrate on building up our forces to invade England next year.  You and your men will rest and refit for a key role in our invasion.  I am happy to inform you that you are promoted to Feldmarschall!
column2: 漂亮的工作。您实现了总参谋部的期望！您向阿夫朗什的推进迫使最后的美军和英军部队撤离欧洲。现在我们可以集中力量积蓄部队，准备明年入侵英格兰。您和您的部下将休整并补充装备，在我们的入侵行动中承担关键角色。我很高兴地通知您，您已被晋升为元帅！

column1: Como? This situation is absolutely unacceptable. The Republicans have prevailed and now their murderous units are marching into the Asturian Mountains, where they will put many civilians at risk.  You'll soon have a meeting with a court martial General.
column2: 什么？这种局面绝对不可接受。共和派占了上风，如今他们那些嗜杀成性的部队正开进阿斯图里亚斯山区，那里会有许多平民陷入危险。你很快就会去见军事法庭的将军。

column1: Como?... Al parecer, the Basque troops are now in Vitoria.  Our operations in the center of Spain have been discontinued in order to gather some reserves from our southern columns to repair your ''problems'' at Alava.
column2: 什么？……看来巴斯克部队现已进入维多利亚。我们在西班牙中部的作战已经中止，以便从南方各纵队抽调一些预备队来收拾你在阿拉瓦的“麻烦”。

column1: Congratulations on completing your mission satisfactorily.
column2: 祝贺你令人满意地完成了任务。

column1: Congratulations on completing your most recent campaign on schedule.
column2: 祝贺你按期完成了最近这次战役。

column1: Congratulations on meeting your objectives in Norway.
column2: 祝贺你完成了在挪威的各项目标。

column1: Congratulations on your crushing victory over the Soviets, a triumph most impressive. Russia has surrendered! Now, America must be dealt with.
column2: 祝贺你对苏军取得的压倒性胜利，这是一场极为辉煌的胜利。俄国已经投降！现在必须对付美国。

column1: Congratulations on your early success in Italy. Unfortunately, the Allies have been able to fight their way onto the Italian mainland.
column2: 祝贺你在意大利取得的初期战果。遗憾的是，盟军还是杀上了意大利本土。

column1: Congratulations on your excellent defense of the Italian mainland. To date, you have done a good job defending Southern Italy. Unfortunately, the Allies have been able to fight their way onto the Italian mainland.
column2: 祝贺你对意大利本土的出色防御。迄今为止，你对意大利南部的防守做得很好。遗憾的是，盟军还是杀上了意大利本土。

column1: Congratulations on your outstanding victory in France. Our humiliation of 1918 is avenged.
column2: 祝贺你在法国取得的卓越胜利。1918年的屈辱已然洗雪。

column1: Congratulations on your stunning success in the Ukraine. Many Soviet troops have been destroyed or have surrendered.
column2: 祝贺你在乌克兰取得的惊人胜利。大量苏军被歼灭或投降。

column1: Congratulations on your stunning victory. England has surrendered and the war in the west is now over. Now, the war in the east will begin. While you and your army rested, we conquered Yugoslavia and Greece. You should now be ready to play a key role in Barbarossa, the assault on Russia.
column2: 祝贺你取得这场辉煌的胜利。英国已经投降，西线战事至此结束。现在，东线的战争即将开始。在你和你的部队休整期间，我们已征服南斯拉夫与希腊。你现在应当准备好，在进攻俄国的巴巴罗萨行动中发挥关键作用。

column1: Congratulations on your victory in France. Our humiliation of 1918 is avenged.
column2: 祝贺你在法国取得的胜利。1918年的屈辱已然洗雪。

column1: Coup de Grace: Smashing the Ebro's Army
column2: 致命一击：粉碎埃布罗河集团军

column1: Crusade in Spain: North in Flames
column2: 西班牙十字军：北方烽火

column1: Dateline Berlin - August 15, 1945. The war is over. A peace agreement between the United States and Germany is signed. Our armed forces failure to capture Washington, D.C., and the use by the United States on August 6th of an atomic bomb are the reasons cited for the peace accord. We are pleased peace has come but are sorry to report that the commander of the invasion forces is confirmed killed alongside his troops in the atomic explosion. He will long be remembered as one of history's greatest military minds in the hearts of our people for his contribution to peace.
column2: 柏林电——1945年8月15日。战争结束了。美国与德国签署和平协定。据称，和约的达成，缘于我军未能攻占华盛顿特区，以及美国于8月6日使用了原子弹。和平降临，我们感到欣慰，但遗憾地报告：入侵部队司令已确认与他的部队一同殒命于原子爆炸之中。为了他对和平的贡献，我们的民众将长久铭记他是历史上最伟大的军事英才之一。

column1: Despite acheiving a satisfactory outcome in the Caucasus, the Soviet winter offensives have forced us back along the entire front, putting us in an extremely difficult position. We must now plan accordingly.
column2: 尽管在高加索取得了令人满意的战果，苏军的冬季攻势仍迫使我们全线后退，使我们陷入极其困难的处境。我们现在必须相应调整计划。

column1: Despite your valiant effort in slowing the breakout from Normandy, the Allies continue to race across the countryside.
column2: 尽管你为迟滞诺曼底方向的突破英勇作战，盟军仍在乡野间长驱直入。

column1: Due to your delay, the Allies were able to evacuate their oil reserves from Tebessa.
column2: 由于您的拖延，盟军得以将他们的石油储备从泰贝萨撤走。

column1: Due to your pathetic speed, they have escaped and we cannot chase them because our reports say that Monty is preparing a big offensive in the sector of Mareth Line.
column2: 由于您那可怜的速度，他们逃脱了，而我们无法追击，因为报告称蒙蒂正在马雷斯防线一带准备一场大规模攻势。

column1: Egypt is already in our hands, now, the Mediterraneans's coasts need to be secured, go quickly!
column2: 埃及已在我们手中，现在需要确保地中海沿岸的安全，快速行动！

column1: El Cairo has been cleared. Now, the next aim is to complete the conquest of the Suez Canal.
column2: 开罗已被肃清。下一个目标是完成对苏伊士运河的征服。

column1: England now lies open to invasion, ensuring total victory on the western front. The invasion is planned to occur on September 1st, but a debate at the highest level of government is in progress. Some believe that we should invade Spain in order to take Gibraltar and thus free the Italian Navy to assist us against the powerful British Navy. Others believe this to be unnecessary and they are winning the argument. Your opinion could influence the outcome of this key decision. The assistance of the Italian Fleet could be the difference in the upcoming invasion, but it may come at the cost of some of your prestige.
column2: 英格兰现已门户洞开，可实施入侵，从而确保西线的全面胜利。入侵计划于 9月1日发起，但政府最高层正就此展开争论。一些人认为我们应入侵西班牙，夺取直布罗陀，从而使意大利海军腾出手来协助我们对强大的英国海军作战。另一些人认为此举没有必要，而且他们的意见正占上风。你的看法可能影响这一关键决策的结果。意大利舰队的协助可能成为即将到来的入侵中的决定性因素，但也许会以你的一部分声望为代价。

column1: Esto es un desastre!  Your attack has best crushed and our units destroyed. The enemy has consolidated their positions around Teruel and now we have suspended our attack on the Mediterranean.
column2: 这是一场灾难！你的进攻被粉碎，我们的部队被歼灭。敌军已在特鲁埃尔周边巩固阵地，现在我们已中止向地中海的进攻。

column1: Esto es un desastre!. Our attack has been crushed and our units destroyed.  The enemies have consolidated their positions around San Sebastian and now the north is a dangerous knife aiming at Navarra and Castilla, the backbone of our advance on to Madrid...
column2: 这是一场灾难！我们的进攻被粉碎，部队被歼灭。敌军已在圣塞瓦斯蒂安周边巩固阵地，如今北方成了一把危险的尖刀，直指纳瓦拉和卡斯蒂利亚——我们向马德里推进的支柱……

column1: Europe is now united under German leadership. You have achieved the success that Napoleon only dreamed of. Now it is time for you to end the war. The Americans have long thought themselves secure because of the vastness of the oceans washing their shores. But, your initial landings in Delaware and Maryland have shaken popular confidence. They have mustered their forces to defend their capital and you must crush the defenders and seize all your objectives in and around Washington, D.C. by August 15th at the latest. Confidentially, we have reports that the US is constructing a super weapon that could totally reverse the course of this war. This weapon may be available as early as mid-July so it is imperative that you force an American surrender as early as possible.
column2: 欧洲现已在德国领导下统一。你取得了拿破仑当年只能梦想的成就。现在，该由你来结束这场战争了。美国人一向自恃两洋浩瀚、海水环抱其海岸而高枕无忧。但是，你在特拉华和马里兰的初期登陆已经动摇了民众的信心。他们已集结兵力保卫首都，你必须击溃守军，至迟于8月15日夺取华盛顿特区城内及周边的全部目标。据机密报告，美国正在研制一种可能彻底扭转战局的超级武器。这种武器最早可能在7月中旬投入使用，因此你必须尽早迫使美国投降。

column1: Excelente! Excelente!  All of  north Spain is now into our hands. We can now turn our attention to the center front.  Your next destination will be Aragon.   We are formulating a special operation to reach the Mediterranean and take Valencia, the new Republican capital.
column2: 好极了！好极了！整个西班牙北方现在都在我们手中。我们现在可以把注意力转向中部前线。你的下一个目标是阿拉贡。我们正在制订一项特别行动，以进抵地中海并夺取共和派的新首都巴伦西亚。

column1: Excelente, excelente!  The enemy offensive was ill conceived and the Republicans have been stopped.    This forced them to discontinue their ''advance'' on Vitoria.  General, we will soon initiate future operations in the North.
column2: 好极了，好极了！敌人的攻势考虑不周，共和派已被挡住。这迫使他们中止了对维多利亚的“推进”。将军，我们很快将在北方发起新的作战。

column1: Excellent ! The campaign has reached its end!
Excellent performance, Herr General.  Leningrad is ours!  Now we must strike quickly towards Moscow while we have the initiative over the Bolsheviks.
column2: 出色的表现，将军阁下。列宁格勒属于我们了！现在我们必须趁掌握对布尔什维克的先手之机，迅速向莫斯科发起进攻。

column1: Excellent performance, Herr General.  The conquest of Cairo and the Suez Kanal should now be easy, especially for Feldmarschall Rommel.  Since the Bolsheviks have begun a great offensive in the Kursk region, while Feldmarschall Paulus is still unable to break out of Stalingrad, the General Staff has decided that you and your men are to be transferred back to the Russian front where you have performed so well in the past.
column2: 出色的表现，将军阁下。现在征服开罗和苏伊士运河应当轻而易举，尤其是对隆美尔元帅而言。由于布尔什维克已在库尔斯克地区发起大规模攻势，而保卢斯元帅仍未能从斯大林格勒突围，总参谋部已决定将您和您的部下调回俄国前线——您过去在那里表现出色。

column1: Excellent work, Herr General.  With Sevastopol in our hands our advances on Stalingrad and the Caucaus can proceed.  Your success here has led the General Staff to give you the critical assignment of taking Stalingrad, while Feldmarschall Manstein will conquer the Caucaus.
column2: 干得漂亮，将军阁下。塞瓦斯托波尔已在我们手中，我们向斯大林格勒和高加索的推进可以继续了。您在此处的成功使总参谋部决定，把夺取斯大林格勒这一关键任务交给您，而曼施坦因元帅将征服高加索。

column1: Excellent! After this great victory, the 8th army won't be able to make a quick reorganization, this is our chance to take the initiative, we will chase the Allies towards the west.
column2: 出色！经过这场大胜，第8集团军无法迅速重整，这是我们的机会——夺取先手，我们将把盟军向西追击。

column1: Excellent!! you've captured the oil reserves found in Tebessa!
column2: 好极了！！您夺取了泰贝萨发现的石油储量！

column1: Excellent!, thanks to your determination, the Burma front remains in a stable condition.
column2: 好极了！多亏您的坚定决心，缅甸战线仍保持着稳定的态势。

column1: Excellent, you've captured the oil reserves found in Tebessa.
column2: 好极了，你已夺取泰贝萨的石油储备。
阿斯图里亚斯的最后阶段

column1: For weeks our troops have been stopped by Russian forces near Kiev. It is time for you to encircle and destroy their positions. You are hereby ordered to strike south toward Kiev and Lokhvitsa. Army Group South units, temporarily under your command, are to drive north and meet your forces, thus encircling the Russian armies. All of the objectives in your sector must be taken by September 19th in order for us to redeploy your troops in time for an attack on Moscow this year. An earlier completion of this battle can only enhance your prestige, and give you a better chance to obtain the resources you will need to capture Moscow.
column2: 数周以来，我军在基辅附近一直受阻于苏军。现在该由你将其阵地合围并歼灭。兹命令你向南进攻，直取基辅和洛赫维察。暂归你指挥的南方集团军群部队将向北推进，与你部会合，从而对苏军形成合围。你战区内的所有目标必须在9月19日前夺取，以便我们及时重新部署你的部队，用于今年对莫斯科的进攻。提前结束此战只会提升你的声望，并让你更有机会获得攻取莫斯科所需的资源。

column1: For your excellent leadership, you have been appointed as the commander of our combined land, naval, and air assault on Norway, code named Operation Weserubung. Your goal is to capture all objectives in southern and central Norway by May 3rd. Your forces must be free to redeploy for the upcoming campaign in France which is slated to begin May 10th. You should complete your mission as early as you can. This will allow us a greater chance to rest, refit and upgrade your troops prior to the invasion of France.
column2: 鉴于你出色的领导才能，你已被任命为对挪威陆海空联合突击的指挥官，此次行动代号威悉演习行动。你的目标是在5月3日前夺取挪威南部与中部的所有目标。你的部队必须能够自由重新部署，以参加定于5月10日开始的法国战役。你应尽早完成任务。这将使我们有更大机会在入侵法国之前让部队休整、整补与升级。

column1: Fortunately the British offensive has been stopped. However we must withdraw our units to safer positions.
column2: 幸运的是，英军的攻势已被阻止。不过我们必须把部队撤到更安全的位置。
加扎拉防线 [忒修斯行动]

column1: General, welcome to the East. Let me brief you. The government in Berlin has finally decided that it is time to destroy our sworn enemies - the Bolsheviks. Your attack here at Brest-Litowsk will be the opening hour of Operation Barbarossa. Along a front line 3000km long, guns will open fire. The enemy should be completely surprised and you'll be able to cross the Bug river with almost no resistance. Good luck all the same!
column2: 将军，欢迎来到东方。我来为您做简报。柏林政府终于决定，是时候消灭我们誓不两立的敌人——布尔什维克了。您在此地对布列斯特-立托夫斯克的进攻，将是巴巴罗萨行动的开场时刻。在长达3000公里的战线上，火炮将同时开火。敌人应当会完全措手不及，您将几乎不会遇到抵抗就能渡过布格河。还是祝您好运！

column1: Gibraltar has been taken and the Italian Fleet has sailed toward England. Your mission is to take London and the Industrial Heart of England before our limited shipping and storms in the English Channel force us to withdraw our invasion. High command has given you until September 30th to complete your mission, but we fear that you must succeed sooner or we will see the invasion falter before the British surrender. Operation Sealion is about to begin. Good Luck!
column2: 直布罗陀已被攻占，意大利舰队已驶向英格兰。你的任务是夺取伦敦以及英格兰的工业心脏地带，必须在我们有限的航运能力与英吉利海峡的风暴迫使我们撤出入侵部队之前完成。统帅部给你完成任务的期限是9月30日，但我们担心你必须更早取胜，否则入侵将在英国人投降之前便告夭折。海狮行动即将开始。祝好运！

column1: Gibraltar is ours, thanks mainly to the skill of Feldmarschall Kesselring in breaking through the defenses on the Spanish side.  Of course, our ally Spain will be given nominal soverignty over Gibraltar, but it will serve us as our base.  Herr General, you did not handle this difficult assignment with the skill you have shown in previous battles.  However, you will be given another chance.  After some rest and recuperation you and your men will probably be called upon to play a role in our 1941 spring campaign.
column2: 直布罗陀属于我们了，这主要归功于凯塞林元帅突破西班牙一侧防御的技艺。当然，我们的盟友西班牙将被授予对直布罗陀的名义主权，但它将作为我们的基地供我们使用。将军阁下，您并未以在以往战役中展现的技艺来完成这项艰巨任务。不过，我们会再给您一次机会。经过一段休整之后，您和您的部下很可能会被召去在我们1941年春季攻势中发挥作用。

column1: Good work, Herr General.  With Stalingrad in our hands we can now choose our next move.  Intelligence indicates that the Western Allies are planning a landing in Northwest Afrika.  The General Staff has decided to send significant reinforcements to the Afrika Corps, so you and your men are to transfer to Afrika after a thorough rest and refitting.  Meanwhile Feldmarschall von Paulus's Sixth Army will take your place in Stalingrad.
column2: 干得好，将军阁下。斯大林格勒已在我们手中，现在我们能选择下一步行动了。情报显示，西方盟军正计划在西北非登陆。总参谋部已决定向非洲军派出大量增援，因此您和您的部下将在充分休整和补充装备后调往非洲。与此同时，冯·保卢斯元帅的第6集团军将接替您在斯大林格勒的防务。
哈勒法亚隘口与塞卢姆之战

column1: Herr Feldmarschall, due to your unprecedented advance, we will soon see the triumphant finish of our English campaign.  Feldmarschall von Manstein's Army Group North is within 100 kilometers of Glasgow, and .....  excuse me, Herr Feldmarschall .....
column2: 元帅阁下，由于您前所未有的推进，我们即将迎来英格兰战役的胜利终局。曼施坦因元帅的北方集团军群距格拉斯哥已不足100公里，而且……请原谅，元帅阁下……

column1: Herr Feldmarschall, thank God you are here.  Our situation is critical. Buda-Pest is besieged by the Bolsheviks. Your troops must force their way into the city. It is doubtful that our Hungarian allies will continue to fight if Buda-Pest falls. If you can drive the Reds into the Danube, we may stop the Russian Bear from consuming us.
column2: 元帅阁下，谢天谢地您来了。我们的形势十分危急。布达佩斯已被布尔什维克围困。您的部队必须强行突入城中。布达佩斯一旦陷落，我们的匈牙利盟友是否还会继续作战就很难说了。如果您能把红军赶进多瑙河，我们或许能阻止俄国熊吞掉我们。

column1: Herr Feldmarschall, the Bosheviks are retreating everywhere! Feldmarschall Guderian has retaken the Baku oil fields, while Feldmarschall Manstein has surrounded Moscow.  As part of our campaign to keep the Bolsheviks on the run, you are to cross the Don river.
column2: 元帅阁下，布尔什维克正在全线退却！古德里安元帅已夺回巴库油田，曼施坦因元帅则包围了莫斯科。作为我们让布尔什维克持续溃逃的作战的一部分，您要渡过顿河。

column1: Herr Feldmarschall.  We have obtained an armistice with England and the United States.  Bravo!  But while we were conquering England the Bolsheviks treacherously broke our armistice with them and invaded our allied territories in Eastern Europe.  With the bulk of our forces in England and Afrika the situation is critical. Your forces are the only units standing between them and Berlin. You MUST stop them.
column2: 元帅阁下。我们已与英国和美国达成停战。太好了！但就在我们征服英格兰之际，布尔什维克背信弃义地撕毁与我们之间的停战协定，入侵了我们在东欧的盟国领土。由于我军主力都在英格兰和非洲，形势十分危急。您的部队是挡在他们与柏林之间的唯一力量。您必须阻止他们。

column1: Herr Feldmarshall, I am at a loss for words.  Your failure is...  incomprehensible. This debacle will be remembered as one of the worst military disasters of our nation.  It is better for you that you will never return to the fatherland.  Much better.
column2: 元帅阁下，我已无言以对。您的失败……令人无法理解。这场溃败将被记为我国最惨重的军事灾难之一。对您来说，最好永远不要回到祖国。最好如此。

column1: Herr General,  it is your privilege to lead our attack here, south of Novgorod, in the Russian heartland.  A successful offensive here will sever communications between Moscow and Leningrad and trap several Soviet armies. It is, of course, imperative to take your objectives quickly.  Our thoughts are with you.
column2: 将军阁下，能在俄国腹地的诺夫哥罗德以南率领此次进攻，是您的殊荣。此处攻势若成，将切断莫斯科与列宁格勒之间的交通，并围困数个苏军集团军。当然，迅速夺取目标势在必行。我们挂念着您。

column1: Herr General, as you know the Allies landed in Northwest Afrika in November and have been been driving east ever since.  It is imperative not only that their drive be stopped, but that they be thrown out of Tunesia!  We thought to assign this task to Feldmarschall Rommel, but Feldmarschalls Kesselring and Manstein have argued that he is needed to continue the drive on the Suez Kanel.  We have therefore given you this critical assigment.  Herr General, do not disappoint.
column2: 将军阁下，如您所知，盟军已于11月在西北非登陆，此后一路向东推进。不仅必须阻止他们的推进，还必须把他们逐出突尼斯！我们本想把这项任务交给隆美尔元帅，但凯塞林元帅和曼施坦因元帅认为他需要继续向苏伊士运河推进。因此我们把这项关键任务交给了您。将军阁下，请勿让我们失望。

column1: Herr General, as you know the Allies landed in Northwest Afrika in November and have been been driving east ever since.  It is imperative not only that their drive be stopped, but that they be thrown out of Tunisia!  We thought to assign this task to Feldmarschall Rommel, but Feldmarschalls Kesselring and Manstein have argued that he is needed to continue the drive on the Suez Kanel.  We have therefore given you this critical assigment.  Herr General, do not disappoint.
column2: 将军阁下，如您所知，盟军已于11月在西北非登陆，此后一路向东推进。不仅必须阻止他们的推进，还必须把他们逐出突尼斯！我们本想把这项任务交给隆美尔元帅，但凯塞林元帅和曼施坦因元帅认为他需要继续向苏伊士运河推进。因此我们把这项关键任务交给了您。将军阁下，请勿让我们失望。

column1: Herr General, as you know the Kursk Salient poses a serious threat to us. The enemy is counterattacking and our only hope to seal the break in the lines is your Kampfgruppe. You must stop the Soviet counterattack immediately. Good Luck.
column2: 将军阁下，如您所知，库尔斯克突出部对我们构成严重威胁。敌人正在反攻，我们堵住战线缺口的唯一希望就是您的战斗群。您必须立即阻止苏军反攻。祝好运。

column1: Herr General, as you know, Germany has declared war on the Soviet Union.  You have been chosen to play a key role in our drive into southern Russia. You will assist our Romanian Allies in their attempt to reclaim their lost province of Moldavia. The key city in this province is Kishinev, and it is also your primary objective.  Not only is this assignment strategically important, it is politically critical.  The world is watching, Herr General, do not disappoint.
column2: 将军阁下，如你所知，德国已对苏联宣战。你被选中在我们向俄国南部的进军中发挥关键作用。你将协助我们的罗马尼亚盟友，设法收复他们失去的摩尔达维亚省。这个省的关键城市是基什尼奥夫，它也是你的首要目标。这项任务不仅在战略上重要，在政治上同样至关重要。全世界都在注视，将军阁下，不要让我们失望。

column1: Herr General, as you know, the Allies are pushing inland from St. Lo in an attempt to break out from their beachhead in Normandy.  Your assignment is to stop this assault, then counterattack and force them back on Cherbourgh.  Success here is critical, as an Allied breakout could threaten the Reich!
column2: 将军阁下，如您所知，盟军正从圣洛向内陆推进，试图从他们在诺曼底的登陆场突围。您的任务是阻止这次进攻，然后实施反击，把他们压回瑟堡。此处的成功至关重要，因为盟军一旦突围，就可能威胁到帝国！

column1: Herr General, I know that you and your men have not had time even to catch a breath, but the situation here is critical. Buda-Pest is besieged by the Bolsheviks. Your troops must force their way into the city. It is doubtful that our Hungarian allies will continue to fight if Buda-Pest falls. If you can drive the Reds into the Danube, we may stop the Russian Bear from consuming us.
column2: 将军阁下，我知道你和你的部下连喘口气的时间都没有，但此地局势十分危急。布达佩斯正被布尔什维克围困。你的部队必须强行突入城内。如果布达佩斯陷落，我们的匈牙利盟友是否还会继续作战就很值得怀疑了。如果你能把赤色分子赶进多瑙河，我们或许还能阻止那头俄国熊把我们吞掉。

column1: Herr General, I must congratulate you on this brilliant success. Gibraltar is ours.  Of course, our ally Spain will be given nominal soverignty over Gibraltar, but it will serve us as our base.  You handled this difficult assignment well.  After some well-earned rest and recuperation you and your men will undoubtedly be called upon to play a key role in our 1941 spring campaign.
column2: 将军阁下，我必须祝贺您取得这一辉煌成功。直布罗陀属于我们了。当然，我们的盟友西班牙将被授予对直布罗陀的名义主权，但它将作为我们的基地供我们使用。您出色地完成了这项艰巨任务。经过一段应得的休整之后，您和您的部下无疑将被召去在我们1941年春季攻势中发挥关键作用。

column1: Herr General, our drive on Moscow has been quite successful, but enemy resistance continues to stiffen.  You must break through along the Volokolamsk Highway.   There is no doubt; the enemy will commit his toughest units to defend the capital, but we will persevere.
column2: 将军阁下，我们对莫斯科的推进相当顺利，但敌军抵抗日益顽强。您必须沿沃洛科拉姆斯克公路实施突破。毫无疑问，敌人必将投入其最精锐的部队保卫首都，但我们定能坚持到底。

column1: Herr General, thanks to your efforts we've achieved a vital breakthrough and it is my pleasure to inform you that your request for leave has been granted. Enjoy your leave!
column2: 将军阁下，多亏您的努力，我们实现了至关重要的突破，我很荣幸地通知您，您的休假申请已获批准。祝您休假愉快！

column1: Herr General, the enemy is making a final attempt to break out of the encirclement in Normandy around the key city of Avranches. Your orders are to move swiftly and prevent this outbreak and force the Allies out of Europe. With Fortress Europe secure, and the Luftwaffe's success in dealing with Allied bombing raids, we will be able to build up our forces to invade England next year.
column2: 将军阁下，敌人正做最后努力，试图从诺曼底包围圈中、围绕重镇阿夫朗什突围。您的命令是迅速行动，阻止这次突围，并把盟军赶出欧洲。欧洲堡垒一旦稳固，加上德国空军在应对盟军轰炸行动中取得的成功，我们就能积蓄力量，于明年入侵英格兰。

column1: Herr General, the enemy is making an attempt to break out of the encirclement in Normandy around the key city of Avranches. Your orders are to move swiftly and prevent this outbreak.
column2: 将军阁下，敌军正试图在诺曼底从阿夫朗什这座关键城市附近的包围圈中突围。您的命令是迅速行动，阻止这次突围。

column1: Herr General, this victory is worthy of great praise. The Allies's attempted breakout has been stopped and now the only part of France they still hold is the area north of Avranches.  We must now take Avranches and expel the Allies from Europe!
column2: 将军阁下，这场胜利值得高度赞扬。盟军试图突围的行动已被阻止，如今他们在法国仅剩的占领区就是阿夫朗什以北地区。现在我们必须夺取阿夫朗什，把盟军赶出欧洲！

column1: Herr General, though able to achieve some success, you did not show the initiative demanded of German field commanders.  You were expected to do more than merely follow orders. The Bolsheviks still defy us and we need to regroup our forces.
column2: 将军阁下，您虽然取得了一些战果，却没有展现出德国野战指挥官应有的主动精神。人们对您的期望不止是循规蹈矩地执行命令。布尔什维克仍在顽抗，我们需要重新集结部队。

column1: Herr General, we have underestimated the Bolsheviks' powers of resistance. They have crossed the Don and completely encircled Sixth Army. You must drive on Kletskaya and Serafimov to reestablish contact. We will never, never surrender to the Red Army, but in order for us to hold our position, you must prevail. Good Luck.
column2: 将军阁下，我们低估了布尔什维克的抵抗能力。他们已渡过顿河，彻底包围了第六集团军。你必须向克列茨卡亚和谢拉菲莫维奇推进，以恢复联系。我们绝不会，绝不会向红军投降，但为了守住阵地，你必须取胜。祝好运。

column1: Herr General, you must break through and encircle the enemy along the Polish frontier, exploiting their lack of mobility.  We will send pre-emptive strikes to destroy the Polish air force, therefore no aircraft will impede your advance.  Speed is essential; a successful advance here will allow us to threaten Warsaw from the north and east simultaneously.  In addition, we can welcome our Soviet friends to the key city of Brest-Litovsk on the new German-Soviet border.  The General Staff will not be pleased if it is the Soviets who welcome us instead.
column2: 将军阁下，您必须沿波兰边境实施突破并包围敌军，充分利用其机动性不足的弱点。我们将发动先发制人的打击摧毁波兰空军，因此不会有敌机阻碍您的推进。速度至关重要；此处的成功推进将使我们得以从北面和东面同时威胁华沙。此外，我们还能够在德苏新边界上的重镇布列斯特-立托夫斯克迎接我们的苏联友军。倘若反过来是苏联人迎接我们，总参谋部绝不会高兴。

column1: Herr General, you must quickly crush the defenses of Tobruk and finish what you have so successfully begun.  If Tobruk falls into our hands, the British will never recover.  Now is our chance to drive them into the sea.
column2: 将军阁下，你必须迅速粉碎托布鲁克的防御，把你如此成功地开始的事业进行到底。如果托布鲁克落入我们手中，英国人将永远无法恢复。现在正是我们把他们赶下海的机会。

column1: Herr General, your victory at Narvik allows us an opportunity to crush our old enemy, France.  Their army is said to be the world's finest.  We shall see!  Now, we believe the Allies plan to push into Belgium in response to our offensive.  Your task is to lead your forces through the Ardennes and emerge behind the enemy.  Our victory at Sedan in 1870 made Germany a Great Power.  Your victory at Sedan will return us to that status.
column2: 将军阁下，您在纳尔维克取得的胜利为我们创造了粉碎宿敌法国的机会。据说他们的陆军是世界上最优秀的。我们走着瞧！如今我们认为，盟军计划针对我们的攻势向比利时推进。您的任务是率领部队穿越阿登，出现在敌军背后。1870年我们在色当的胜利使德国成为列强。您在色当的胜利将让我们重返那一地位。

column1: Herr General.  Now that Leningrad has fallen it only remains to capture Moscow and force the Bolsheviks to make peace on our terms.  You have been chosen to lead this critical attack.
column2: 将军阁下。既然列宁格勒已经陷落，剩下的只是攻取莫斯科，迫使布尔什维克按我们的条件媾和。您被选中率领这次关键进攻。

column1: Herr General.  Our goal is to seize Stalingrad as a base which will allow us to turn either north towards Moscow or south towards the Caucasian oil fields.  You have been chosen to lead our initial drive towards Stalingrad.
column2: 将军阁下。我们的目标是夺取斯大林格勒作为基地，以便此后或北上莫斯科，或南下高加索油田。您被选中率领我们向斯大林格勒发起的最初攻势。

column1: Herr General.  Your brilliant leadership has brought us once again to Moscow.  This time we must capture the enemy capital and principal city and force the Bolsheviks to make peace on our terms.  The General Staff has given you this critical task, do not fail!
column2: 将军阁下。您卓越的指挥再次把我们带到了莫斯科城下。这一次我们必须夺取敌国首都和首要城市，迫使布尔什维克按我们的条件媾和。总参谋部把这一关键任务交给了您，切勿失败！

column1: Herr General.  Your capture of Moscow once again showed your mastery of tactics.  The Bolsheviks still refuse to surrender but have offered us an armistice.  Our intelligence indicates that the Allies are planning an invasion of Europe early this summer.  Therefore the High Command signed the armistice with the Bolsheviks so we can prepare for the pending invasion.  You are to be transferred to the Western Front, where you will help defend Fortress Europe against an Allied invasion.
column2: 将军阁下。您攻占莫斯科再次展现了您的战术造诣。布尔什维克仍拒绝投降，但已向我们提出停战。我们的情报显示，盟军正计划在今年初夏入侵欧洲。因此最高统帅部与布尔什维克签署了停战协定，以便为即将到来的入侵做准备。您将被调往西线，协助保卫欧洲堡垒，抵御盟军入侵。

column1: I think it would be good to place an article in the Volkischer Beobachter stating that the general of the XXII Pz division died while commanding his tanks in the front line.
column2: 我认为最好在《人民观察家报》上刊登一篇文章，称第22装甲师师长在前线指挥坦克作战时阵亡。

column1: Irun - Closing the Spanish - French border
column2: 伊伦——封锁西班牙-法国边境

column1: It is imperative that we regain the initiative by launching a counterattack to retake Kharkov, a city recently taken by advancing Soviet armies. If you are able to retake Kharkov and all other objectives by March 14th, we should be in a position to launch a major offensive aimed at Kursk in the summer. An early victory at Kharkov will make it easier for us to overwhelm the Soviets when the weather turns warm again.
column2: 我们必须发起反攻、夺回哈尔科夫，以重夺先手——该城不久前被推进中的苏军攻占。如果你能在3月14日前夺回哈尔科夫及所有其他目标，我们就能在夏季对库尔斯克发动一场大规模攻势。哈尔科夫的早日胜利，将使我军在天气再度转暖后更容易压倒苏军。

column1: It is time for us to end British domination over the entire Middle East. If we succeed, we may be able to influence the war in Russia by opening a new invasion route through the Caucasus. Your many objectives in the Middle East must be taken before major British reinforcements are able to arrive this fall, or all gains may be lost. In any event, we expect you to take your objectives by November 15th at the latest.
column2: 现在是我们终结英国对整个中东统治的时候了。若能成功，我们或许可以通过开辟一条穿越高加索的新入侵路线来影响俄国战局。你必须在今年秋季英国大批增援抵达之前夺取中东的众多目标，否则一切战果都可能丧失。无论如何，我们期望你最迟于11月15日夺取各项目标。

column1: It is time for you to teach the British a lesson in desert warfare. You are to take all of your objectives, including Tobruk and Mersah Matruh, and thus clear the road to Cairo by June 30th. Earlier success could prove decisive, as the British presence on Malta is likely to make our supply situation in North Africa increasingly precarious.
column2: 现在是你给英国人上一堂沙漠战课的时候了。你须夺取包括托布鲁克与马特鲁港在内的所有目标，从而在6月30日前打通通往开罗的道路。更早取得成功可能具有决定性意义，因为英军在马耳他的存在很可能使我军在北非的补给状况日益岌岌可危。

column1: Ja Wolfgang, I was as surprised as you that they chose Normandy.... Ah, Herr General, come in. Allow me to explain the present situation. We have a chance to drive the Allies back into the sea, here, near Caen. I will not pretend that this will be an easy task, but you have shown yourself to be a most resourceful fellow time and time again, ja? You will need all your skill to wrest a victory here. Our thoughts are with you. Ja, As I was saying, Wolfgang....
column2: 是啊，沃尔夫冈，他们竟选择了诺曼底，我和你一样吃惊……啊，将军阁下，请进。请允许我说明当前局势。我们有机会把盟军赶下海，就在这里，卡昂附近。我不会假装这是一件轻松的事，但你已经一次又一次证明自己足智多谋，是吧？你需要用上全部本领才能在此赢得胜利。我们与你同在。是啊，就像我刚才说的，沃尔夫冈……

column1: Kongratulieren! Now the Suez Canal is under German control! This will be a great help also for our Japanese friends.
column2: 恭喜！现在苏伊士运河已在德国控制之下！这对我们的日本盟友也是极大的帮助。

column1: Kongratulieren! Our elite paratroopers have showed their skills again. The entrance to the Canal is secured and the British won't be able to use it again to resupply their units in Egypt and the Middle East.
column2: 恭喜！我们的精锐伞兵再次展示了他们的本领。运河入口已安全，英国人再也无法利用它为其在埃及和中东的部队提供补给了。

column1: Kongratulieren! The Soviets have been kicked out of Persia, and the British Armies will no longer disturb us here. The Middle East is under our command as well as the oil resources from these lands. In spite of the failure at Stalingrad, our presence in Persia will put pressure on  the Soviet southern borders. We hope the Kursk offensive will be a decisive victory for the Werhmacht, helped now by our big oil supplies...
column2: 恭喜！苏联人已被逐出波斯，英国军队再也不会在此地骚扰我们。中东以及这些土地上的石油资源都已在我们的掌控之下。尽管在斯大林格勒遭遇失败，我们在波斯的存在将对苏联南部边境施加压力。我们希望库尔斯克攻势将成为国防军的一次决定性胜利，如今有了我们大量的石油供应助力……

column1: Kongratulieren!, the High Command is grateful for your actions. We hoped to preserve the front lines, however you have completed the conquest of Cyrenaica.
column2: 恭喜！最高统帅部对您的行动表示感谢。我们本只希望守住战线，而您却完成了对昔兰尼加的征服。

column1: Kongratulieren!, the past year's frontlines have been restored here.
column2: 祝贺！去年的战线已在此地恢复。

column1: La tête de pont de Meigem
Le combat de la Tête de Flandre
Mersa Matruh is taken!, now, we must continue our drive on to Egypt.
column2: 马特鲁港已被拿下！现在，我们必须继续向埃及推进。

column1: Mersa Matruh is taken!, the High Command wants to tell you that Operation Hercules will be launched in the next few hours to take the island of Malta, as a reward for your outstanding actions.
column2: 马特鲁港已被拿下！最高统帅部要告诉您，作为对您杰出表现的奖赏，赫拉克勒斯行动将在未来数小时内发起，以夺取马耳他岛。

column1: Mis felicitaciones General.  The best troops of the Red army have been destroyed at Ebro.  We do not expect any further offensive operations from the Reds and we can soon begin to think of a victorious end to this war.
column2: 向您祝贺，将军。红军最精锐的部队已在埃布罗河被消灭。我们预计赤色分子不会再有进一步的进攻行动，我们很快就可以开始考虑如何胜利结束这场战争了。

column1: Muy bien... The Republicans have been kicked out of Teruel and now they are in total retreat.   They are scrambling for good positions to protect their new capital, Valencia.
column2: 非常好……共和派已被逐出特鲁埃尔，现在他们全线撤退。他们正争相抢占有利阵地，以保卫他们的新首都巴伦西亚。

column1: No siente usted verguenza?. The Republicans are still resisting at the Ebro pocket and are hoping to receive help from France.  We are sure they are going to get it.  Your future is dark, my General.
column2: 你难道不觉得羞耻吗？共和派仍在埃布罗河袋形阵地抵抗，并指望得到法国的援助。我们确信他们会得到援助。你的前途黯淡，我的将军。

column1: Now that Sevastopol has fallen our next objective is Stalingrad.  This is an important road and railroad nexus.  Also capture of a city named after the Bolshevik dictator will hurt their morale.  This is a critical assignment, Herr General, you must take Stalingrad quickly.
column2: 既然塞瓦斯托波尔已经陷落，我们的下一个目标就是斯大林格勒。这是一处重要的公路与铁路枢纽。此外，夺取这座以布尔什维克独裁者命名的城市，将打击他们的士气。将军阁下，这是一项关键任务，您必须迅速拿下斯大林格勒。

column1: Now that we have stopped the Allied assault on Tunis, it's time for us to move westwards. Our next objective is El Alamein - the gateway to  Egypt. The British are present in great strength, but your past performance indicates that you should be able to overcome them.  Again, you must achieve your objectives quickly so we that may maintain our pressure on the British.  You are Feldmarschall Rommel's lead commander in this attack!
column2: 既然我们已经阻止了盟军对突尼斯的进攻，现在该向西行动了。我们的下一个目标是阿拉曼——通往埃及的门户。英军兵力雄厚，但您以往的表现表明您应当能够战胜他们。同样，您必须迅速达成目标，以便我们保持对英军的压力。您是隆美尔元帅此次进攻的先锋指挥官！

column1: Now the coasts are secured and we can go for the inner oil camps.
column2: 如今海岸已安全，我们可以向内陆的油田进发了。

column1: Now we can continue easily towards the major oil reserves in the world, the rear is secure.
column2: 现在我们能轻松地向世界上最大的石油储区推进了，后方已经稳固。

column1: Obviously you have problems choosing which way to go..
column2: 看来您在选择前进方向上遇到了困难……

column1: Obviously you need to take a rest. Another General will replace you now as C-in-C of the DAK. (You are dimised).
column2: 看来你需要休息一下了。另一位将军将接替你出任非洲军总司令。（你被解职了。）
国防军最高统帅部公告：

column1: Once again, we ask you to repel an invasion, but this time Southern France is the allied target. Your job is to hold onto five objectives until after August 28th when we hope to move additional troops to support you. Failing this, you must hold at least two objectives until then.
column2: 我们再次要求你击退一次登陆入侵，但这次盟军的目标是法国南部。你的任务是在 8月28日之后仍守住五个目标，届时我们希望调派更多部队支援你。若无法做到，你至少须在此期限前守住两个目标。

column1: Operation Overlord will be the largest amphibious invasion ever seen by man, and you must stop it. You should strive to pin the Allies in Normandy by holding St. Lo, Caen, St. Mere Eglise, and Cherbourg until after July 5th when we hope reinforcements will arrive and throw the Allies back into the sea. At a minimum, hold at least one of these key towns.
column2: 「霸王」行动将是有史以来规模最大的两栖入侵，你必须阻止它。你应尽力把盟军钉在诺曼底，守住圣洛、卡昂、圣梅尔埃格利斯和瑟堡，直至 7月5日之后，届时我们希望增援到达，把盟军赶下海去。最低限度，也要守住其中至少一座要镇。

column1: Our intelligence reports that the Bolshevik leader Stalin has fled Moscow and is reportedly barricaded in the city of Kazan.  Most of the remaining high-grade Bolshevik troops are also in the Kazan region.  Meanwhile Bolshevik troops elsewhere are beginning to surrender.  Herr Feldmarschall, a quick victory here, especially if you capture Stalin, should lead to the Bolshevik's surrender and end this war!
column2: 我们的情报显示，布尔什维克领袖斯大林已逃离莫斯科，据报正困守喀山城。布尔什维克剩余的大部分精锐部队也都在喀山地区。与此同时，其他地方的布尔什维克部队开始投降。元帅阁下，此处的一场速胜——尤其是如果您能俘获斯大林——应当会促成布尔什维克投降，结束这场战争！

column1: Our objective is Alexandria, the great port of Egypt.  With Alexandria in our possession supply will cease to be a problem.  The British are present in great strength and strongly entrenched, but your past performance indicates that you should be able to overcome them.  They will be supported by the remnants of the British armor, and resupplied British aviation.  The Russians have begun a major offensive in the Kursk region so you must achieve your objectives quickly.
column2: 我们的目标是亚历山大——埃及的大港。亚历山大一旦落入我们手中，补给将不再是问题。英军兵力雄厚且工事坚固，但您以往的表现表明您应当能够战胜他们。他们将得到英军残余装甲部队的支援，并得到重建补充的英国航空兵的补给。俄军已在库尔斯克地区发起大规模攻势，因此您必须迅速达成目标。

column1: Our quick success in North Africa has allowed us to expel the British from Egypt and secure the Suez Canal.
column2: 我们在北非的迅速胜利使我们得以将英国人逐出埃及，并确保苏伊士运河。

column1: Our situation is critical, and we can't continue to hold our front lines here. Our only choice is retreat, and wait for a miracle.
column2: 我们的处境十分危急，无法再在这里维持前线。我们唯一的选择是撤退，等待奇迹出现。

column1: Please, go back, and select your destination.
column2: 请返回并选择您的目的地。

column1: Sevastopol, home of the Soviet Black Sea Fleet, must be taken so that we can begin our upcoming campaign in the Ukraine and the Caucasus without a major enemy fortress threatening our right flank. Sevastopol has been under siege and has been pounded by air and artillery for 5 straight days, but you should expect the entrenchments and forts you attack to be the toughest you have ever faced in the war. You must take Sevastopol and the surrounding objectives by no later than June 23rd or our offensive in the south will be compromised. An earlier completion of your mission will only make it easier to prevail over the Soviets later this year.
column2: 塞瓦斯托波尔是苏联黑海舰队的基地，必须将其攻占，我们才能在没有敌军大型要塞威胁右翼的情况下，展开即将在乌克兰和高加索进行的战役。塞瓦斯托波尔已被围困，并连续5天遭受空中与炮火的打击，但你应当预料到，你所攻击的工事与要塞将是这场战争中你面对过的最坚固的防御。你必须在6月23日之前夺取塞瓦斯托波尔及周边目标，否则我们在南方的攻势将受到牵制。任务越早完成，今年晚些时候压制苏联人就越容易。

column1: Su incompetencia ha resultado funesta para la causa nacional!   The quarters at Gijon have fallen along with the whole city of Oviedo.   I have received reports that the execution of Colonel Aranda will be tomorrow.  Yours may soon follow.
column2: 你的无能给民族事业带来了灾难性后果！希洪的营地已经陷落，奥维耶多全城也随之失守。我收到报告说，阿兰达上校将于明天被处决。你的死期或许也不远了。

column1: Su incompetencia ha resultado funesta para la causa nacional!  Bilbao is a new Madrid and it is rumored that the French are planning to re-open the frontier and send supplies to the Republicans.
column2: 你的无能给民族事业带来了灾难性后果！毕尔巴鄂成了新的马德里，而且有传言说法国人正打算重新开放边境，向共和派运送补给。

column1: Superb performance, Herr Feldmarschall! Our troops are safely ashore in England.  You have helped accomplish what Napoleon could not - the invasion of England!
column2: 卓越的表现，元帅阁下！我军已安全登陆英格兰。您帮助完成了拿破仑未能做到的事——入侵英格兰！

column1: Thanks in large part to your past success in Africa, you now have an opportunity to deal the Russians a critical blow. You must complete the upcoming campaign by November 26th at the latest. The fate of the war in the east is in your hands.
column2: 很大程度上由于你此前在非洲的战绩，你现在有机会给苏军一次决定性打击。你最迟必须在 11月26日前完成即将展开的战役。东线战争的命运掌握在你手中。

column1: The Allies have been able to stop our advance! From now on we cannot carry out any more attacks, because our units are in bad shape. Now will be defending our positions!
column2: 盟军已能阻止我们的推进！从现在起我们无法再发动任何进攻，因为我们的部队状况不佳。现在将转入防御我们的阵地！

column1: The Allies have been able to stop you, we couldn't acomplish the proposed goals. We realize that it was really very hard and you had very few units.
column2: 盟军已能阻止您，我们未能完成预定的目标。我们明白这确实非常艰难，而您手上的部队极少。

column1: The Allies have been thrown off the continent. Bravo!  But while you were driving the Allies into the sea the Bolsheviks treacherously broke our peace treaty and invaded our allied territories in Eastern Europe.  With the bulk of our forces involved on the Western Front and in Afrika they have been able to pollute the sacred soil of the Fatherland and penetrate almost to Berlin!  You MUST stop them.
column2: 盟军已被赶出欧洲大陆。太好了！但就在您把盟军赶下海的时候，布尔什维克背信弃义地撕毁和约，入侵了我们在东欧的盟国领土。由于我军主力深陷西线和非洲，他们得以践踏祖国神圣的土地，几乎突入柏林！您必须阻止他们。

column1: The Allies have been thrown out of Tunesia and are reeling in disarray from the bold strokes you and your brave men have delivered.  Now you must continue this drive and force them to evacuate their bases in Morocco, thus removing this threat to Feldmarschall Rommel's campaign to capture Egypt and the Suez Kanal.
column2: 盟军已被逐出突尼斯，并在您和您勇敢部下的大胆打击下仓皇溃退。现在您必须继续推进，迫使他们撤出摩洛哥的基地，从而消除对隆美尔元帅夺取埃及和苏伊士运河作战的这一威胁。

column1: The Allies have now built up their forces and are about to unleash Operation Cobra, their attempt to break out of the Norman hedgerows once and for all. Your mission is to keep the Allies from pushing far into France until after August 18th. To do this, you should hold Rouen, Evreux, Alencon, and Laval, but at a minimum you must maintain control of at least two of these cities.
column2: 盟军现已完成集结，即将发起「眼镜蛇」行动，企图一举突破诺曼底树篱地带。你的任务是阻止盟军在 8月18日之前深入法国腹地。为此，你应守住鲁昂、埃夫勒、阿朗松和拉瓦勒，但至少必须控制其中两座城市。

column1: The Americans have been preparing to launch a new offensive aimed at taking Rome. You must hold a minimum of four objectives until at least the end of March. If possible, retake and hold Anzio while keeping the Allies from gaining any of the objectives you currently hold.
column2: 美军一直在准备发动一场旨在夺取罗马的新攻势。你至少须守到 3月底，期间保有四个目标。如有可能，夺回并守住安齐奥，同时不让盟军夺取你目前掌握的任何目标。

column1: The Anglo-American attempt to surprise us from behind was a total failure, from now on we can concentrate on thinking about our next offensive target.
column2: 英美军队从背后突袭我们的企图彻底失败，从现在起，我们可以专心考虑下一个进攻目标了。

column1: The Anglo-American's intent to surprise us from behind has failed, now we can concentrate on fighting against Monty at the Mareth Line.
column2: 英美从背后突袭我们的意图已经失败，现在我们可以集中力量在马雷斯防线对抗蒙蒂了。

column1: The assault on Crete will be the largest airborne drop ever attempted. It is up to you to lead the airborne attack and capture airfields in Crete so that your main forces can aid the invasion by both sea and air to crush the Allies on the island. You must ultimately secure all of the objectives on Crete by June 1st at the latest. In order to ensure that our forces are optimally prepared for the upcoming invasion of Russia, a much earlier success is desirable.
column2: 对克里特的突击将是有史以来规模最大的空降行动。由你指挥这次空降进攻，夺取克里特的机场，以便我主力部队从海空两路支援入侵，粉碎岛上的盟军。你最迟必须在 6月1日前夺取克里特的全部目标。为确保我军能以最佳状态准备即将到来的入侵俄国之战，更早取胜则更为理想。

column1: The campaign has reached its end, your duty was superb and better than the historic one. Congratulations and I thank you for playing.
column2: 战役已到尽头，您的表现极为出色，比历史上的表现更好。恭喜，感谢您的游玩。

column1: The enemy has been completely surprised and destroyed by your actions!, now the way to Egypt is clear. Your next mission is to assault the historical port of Alexandria.
column2: 在你的行动下，敌人被彻底打了个措手不及并被歼灭！通往埃及的道路已经打开。你的下一个任务是突击历史名城亚历山大港。

column1: The enemy has been completely surprised and destroyed by your actions!, now, the way to Egypt is clear. Your next mission is to assault the historical port of Alexandria.
column2: 在你的行动下，敌人被彻底打了个措手不及并被歼灭！通往埃及的道路已经打开。你的下一个任务是突击历史名城亚历山大港。

column1: The enemy has been surprised, however we could not get the complete victory, some units have escaped, and surely the British will launch a counteroffensive...
column2: 敌人被打了个措手不及，但我们未能取得全胜，部分敌军逃脱了，英军肯定会发动反攻……

column1: The enemy have stopped our units. We must dig in and await the next British strikes, this won't be easy General...
column2: 敌人挡住了我军。我们必须构筑工事，等待英军的下一次打击，这不会轻松，将军……

column1: The English have surrendered, and Greek resistance has collapsed.  This was primarily due to the brilliant tactics of General Cundarian.  Your performance was mediocre, far below your past record. You will be given another chance.  After some rest and recuperation you and your men will be returned to the Russian front to play a key role in our 1942 spring campaign.
column2: 英国人已经投降，希腊抵抗也已崩溃。这主要归功于昆达里安将军的卓越战术。您的表现平平，远低于您以往的水准。我们会再给您一次机会。经过一段休整之后，您和您的部下将被调回俄国前线，在我们1942年春季攻势中扮演关键角色。

column1: The English have surrendered, and Greek resistance has collapsed.  Your performance has been excellent, and we will continue to rely on your expertise.  Well done!  After some well-earned rest and recuperation you and your men will be returned to the Russian front to play a key role in our 1942 spring campaign.
column2: 英国人已经投降，希腊抵抗也已崩溃。您的表现极为出色，我们将继续倚重您的专长。干得好！经过一段应得的休整之后，您和您的部下将被调回俄国前线，在我们1942年春季攻势中扮演关键角色。

column1: The French are resupplying the Republicans with weapons and ammunition. Thanks to your delay in taking Barcelona, the war will be prolonged.  The Republicans will now resist at the Franco-Spanish border and who knows if Paris will finally launch their army to support the government of Madrid.
column2: 法国人正在向共和派补给武器和弹药。由于你迟迟未能夺取巴塞罗那，战争将被延长。共和派现在将在法西边境抵抗，谁知道巴黎最终会不会出动他们的军队来支持马德里政府。

column1: The General Staff commends you for your outstanding achievements in Norway.
column2: 总参谋部对你在挪威的卓越成就予以嘉奖。

column1: The General Staff has decided that you should lead the attack against the British in North Africa.  Their will to fight has by no means been broken.  If we can push the English out of North Africa, we will gain access to the Suez Canal and the oil-rich Middle East.
column2: 总参谋部已决定由你领导对北非英军的进攻。他们的战斗意志丝毫没有瓦解。如果我们能把英国人赶出北非，就能打开通往苏伊士运河和石油资源丰富的中东的道路。

column1: The General Staff is pleased by your success in Poland.
column2: 总参谋部对你的波兰战果感到满意。

column1: The invasion of Russia will be the largest military operation in history. Your army will spearhead Army Group Center's initial thrust into Russia. You must seize all of your objectives, including the main target of Smolensk, by August 6th. An earlier completion of your mission could allow us to begin the attack on Moscow before the onset of the autumn rain and the winter slows our advance. Rapid and decisive success will be the key to the entire War in the East.
column2: 对俄国的入侵将是有史以来规模最大的军事行动。你的集团军将作为中央集团军群首轮突入俄国的先锋。你必须在 8月6日前夺取全部目标，其中包括主要目标斯摩棱斯克。若能提前完成任务，我们就有可能在秋季降雨与冬季迟滞我军推进之前发起对莫斯科的进攻。迅速而决定性的胜利将是整个东线战事的关键。

column1: The Italians are gratefull for helping them recover their colonies.
column2: 意大利人感谢我们帮他们收复了殖民地。

column1: The oil is ours, German engineers are on the way to put refineries online.
column2: 石油归我们了，德国工程师正在赶来让炼油厂开工。

column1: The Republicans have been kicked out of Teruel and now they are in total retreat.   They are scrambling for good positions to protect their new capital, Valencia.
column2: 共和派已被逐出特鲁埃尔，现在他们全线撤退。他们正争相抢占有利阵地，以保卫他们的新首都巴伦西亚。

column1: The Russians are about to unleash a massive attack aimed at the center of our line. It is up to you to fight against overwhelming odds and keep the Russians from taking Warsaw by August 29th. If possible, hold Warsaw and at least two other objectives until after then and we may yet have an opportunity to reverse the tide of this war.
column2: 苏军即将发起一场针对我战线中央的大规模进攻。你要以绝对劣势的兵力迎战，阻止苏军在 8月29日前夺取华沙。如有可能，在此之后仍守住华沙以及至少另外两个目标，我们或许还有机会扭转这场战争的局势。

column1: The Russians are dazed and reeling from the blows you and your brave men have delivered! Not only did you succeed in relieving Buda-Pest, you drove the Reds back across the Danube. The General Staff is amazed at your performance, Herr Feldmarschall.  Now we must continue to pursue the Bolsheviks.  This time we will not settle for an armistice.
column2: 俄军被您和您勇敢部下的打击弄得晕头转向、溃不成军！您不仅成功为布达佩斯解围，还把红军赶回了多瑙河对岸。总参谋部对您的表现惊叹不已，元帅阁下。现在我们必须继续追击布尔什维克。这一次我们不会满足于停战了。

column1: The Soviet Union has invaded Finland, Herr General, and our Finnish friends have trapped a Soviet division in the town of Suomussalmi. Unfortunately, an even greater Soviet relief force is moving to aid their comrades, and the Finns are outnumbered. It is your task to destroy the isolated enemy and prevent the relief force from reaching him. Of course, due to our non-aggression pact with the Soviet Union, you and your troops will be considered volunteers.  If you are defeated, the General Staff will deny any knowledge of your participation, and you may expect the worst if captured.
column2: 苏联已入侵芬兰，将军阁下，我们的芬兰友军已将一支苏军师围困在苏奥穆萨尔米镇。不幸的是，一支规模更大的苏军救援部队正前去接应他们的同志，而芬兰人兵力处于劣势。您的任务是歼灭这支被孤立的敌军，并阻止救援部队与之会合。当然，鉴于我们与苏联签有互不侵犯条约，您和您的部队将被视为志愿者。倘若您战败，总参谋部将否认知悉您的参与，而您一旦被俘，就别指望有什么好下场。

column1: The time for Operation Citadel has come. You are to attack and destroy the Soviet forces in the Kursk salient. The seizure of several key cities behind the front lines (including Kursk) is the key to this battle. You must capture all of your objectives by July 24th. We must warn you that we expect massive Russian counterattacks in your sector to begin within ten days. If you are unable to take all of your objectives, you must at a minimum hold two objectives.
column2: 堡垒行动的时刻已经到来。你要进攻并歼灭库尔斯克突出部的苏军。夺取前线后方的若干重要城市（包括库尔斯克），是此战的关键。你必须在7月24日前夺取所有目标。必须提醒你，我们预计你所在战区将在十天内遭到苏军的大规模反攻。如果你无法夺取全部目标，至少必须守住两个目标。

column1: The time has come for the decisive battle of 1941. The Soviets have marshalled their troops to defend Moscow the economic and political key to Russia. It is time for you to hurl your forces at Moscow. You must break through their defenses and take Moscow before the combination of winter weather and Siberian reinforcements can steal the initiative. If Moscow can be taken and held this winter, the Soviets will undoubtedly surrender.
column2: 1941年决定性会战的时刻已经到来。苏军已集结兵力保卫莫斯科，此地是俄国经济与政治的关键所在。现在，该由你把部队投向莫斯科了。你必须突破他们的防御，在冬季天气与西伯利亚增援夺走先手之前拿下莫斯科。若能在这个冬季攻占并守住莫斯科，苏联无疑将会投降。

column1: The war in the east has not gone well. The Soviets have proven to be unstoppable, and are now advancing across German soil. You must stop them and push them back along the entire front by taking all objectives, however, if you can hold onto a minimum of six objectives, we may be able to obtain tolerable armistice terms. This is the final battle; you face either death or glory.
column2: 东线战事进展不利。苏军已被证明无法阻挡，如今正越过德国本土推进。你必须夺取全部目标，在全线阻止他们并将其击退；不过，你若能守住至少六个目标，我们或许还能争取到尚可接受的停战条件。这是最后一战；你面临的不是死亡就是荣耀。
通往符拉迪沃斯托克之路

column1: Things have not gone well in the west. The allies have proven to be unstoppable, and are now advancing across German soil. You must stop them and push them back along the entire front by taking all objectives. If you can hold onto a minimum of six objectives, we may be able to obtain tolerable armistice terms. This is the final battle; you face either death or glory.
column2: 西线形势不利。盟军已被证明无法阻挡，如今正越过德国本土推进。你必须夺取全部目标，在全线阻止他们并将其击退。你若能守住至少六个目标，我们或许还能争取到尚可接受的停战条件。这是最后一战；你面临的不是死亡就是荣耀。

column1: This is a disaster!, the British have recaptured Agedabia and Mersa el Brega, and are now driving to Tripoli!!!. Obviously, you are dimissed.
column2: 这是一场灾难！英军已夺回艾季达比耶和梅尔萨布赖加，如今正向的黎波里推进！！！显然，您被解职了。

column1: This is a disaster, now we must make a retreat to Tunis to avoid the complete destruction of the Deutsches Afrikakorps...
column2: 这是一场灾难，现在我们只能撤往突尼斯，以免德意志非洲军全军覆没……

column1: This is a really important victory!, the British have been completely surprised by your Southern "hook". The Gazala Line is destroyed, and also Tobruk has fallen in our hands. Kongratulieren.
column2: 这是一场极其重要的胜利！英军被你从南面的“迂回”完全打了个措手不及。加扎拉防线已被摧毁，托布鲁克也落入我们手中。祝贺。

column1: This zone of Algiers is secure, Italian detachments will stay behind and we will continue our unstoppable advance
column2: 阿尔及尔地区已安全，意大利分遣队将留守，我们要继续势不可挡的推进

column1: To the Philippines and the Pacific.

column2: 联合国军反击 [朝鲜战争]
乌托邦悖论 UTOPIAN PARADOX（版本 1.0a）        （架空：1945年3月高加索山区大会战）

column1: Very Good! We're still advancing with great determination, your strategy showed that you're unstoppable !
column2: 非常好！我们仍以极大的决心推进，您的策略表明您势不可挡！

column1: Very Good! You've demonstrated clearly your superiority, now it's time to advance towards Algeria.
column2: 非常好！您已清楚地证明了自身的优势，现在是向阿尔及利亚推进的时候了。

column1: Very well done!  You have exceeded the General Staff's hopes!  Your drive through the Herangsfjord has broken enemy resistance. And, because of your bold attack, the Norwegian government has sued for peace.  Congratulations!
column2: 干得漂亮！您超出了总参谋部的期望！您穿越海尔扬斯峡湾的推进已粉碎敌军抵抗。而且，由于您的果敢进攻，挪威政府已请求和平。祝贺您！

column1: Very well done, Herr Feldmarschall!  The Bolsheviks are dazed and reeling from the blows you and your brave men have delivered.  You must continue to pursue them.
column2: 干得十分出色，元帅阁下！布尔什维克被您和您勇敢部下的打击弄得晕头转向、溃不成军。您必须继续追击他们。

column1: Very well done, Herr General.  The Allied drive into Tunesia has been stopped.  Your counterattack has thrown them out of Tunesia and sent them reeling in disarray.  This gives us the opportunity to drive the Allies completely out of Northwest Afrika.  Because of your excellent record the General Staff has decided that this critical assigment is yours!
column2: 干得十分出色，将军阁下。盟军向突尼斯的推进已被阻止。您的反击把他们逐出突尼斯，使其仓皇溃退。这给了我们把盟军彻底赶出西北非的机会。鉴于您的优异战绩，总参谋部决定把这项关键任务交给您！

column1: Wacht am Rhein is our best chance to seize the initiative and force the Western Allies to make peace with us. It is essential that you capture all of your objectives by December 31st, or the Allies will be able to move overwhelming forces into the Ardennes to stop our offensive. Brussels is your ultimate objective, but capturing and holding a minimum of four objectives by December 31st could also affect the war favorably.
column2: 莱茵守望行动是我们夺取先手、迫使西线盟军与我方媾和的最佳机会。你必须在 12月31日前夺取全部目标，否则盟军将能调集压倒性兵力进入阿登，阻止我们的攻势。布鲁塞尔是你的最终目标，但若能在 12月31日前夺取并守住至少四个目标，也可能使战局朝有利方向发展。

column1: We are disappointed with your failure to take your objectives in Norway. However, due to your previous success we are willing to overlook your mistakes in Norway and give you another chance to prove you are worthy of command.
column2: 我们对你在挪威未能夺取目标感到失望。不过，鉴于你此前的功绩，我们愿意不计较你在挪威的失误，再给你一次机会，以证明你无愧于指挥之职。

column1: We are preparing for operations next year against the British in North Africa as well as against Yugoslavia and Greece. Your performance to date has been outstanding and we will be happy to allow you to choose your next operation for yourself and your army.
column2: 我们正在筹划明年对北非英军以及对南斯拉夫和希腊的作战。你迄今的表现十分出色，我们乐于让你为自己和你的部队选择下一个作战方向。

column1: We cannot leave Sevastopol on our flank while we advance on Stalingrad and the Caucaus, therefore it must be taken. Sevastopol is the most heavily fortified area in the world, stronger than the Maginot line or even Gibraltar!  This will not be an easy task, Herr General, but the General Staff has confidence in your leadership and resourcefulness.
column2: 在我们向斯大林格勒和高加索推进时，不能把塞瓦斯托波尔留在我们的侧翼，因此必须拿下它。塞瓦斯托波尔是世界上防御最坚固的地区，比马其诺防线甚至直布罗陀还要坚固！将军阁下，这不会是轻松的任务，但总参谋部对您的领导力和足智多谋充满信心。

column1: We don't have a choice, we have to surrender, the lack of supplies don't give us any other option.
column2: 我们别无选择，只能投降，补给匮乏没有给我们别的出路。

column1: We don't have a choice, we have to surrender, the lack of supplies give us no other option.
column2: 我们别无选择，只能投降，补给匮乏使我们没有别的出路。

column1: We have been pleased with your performance on the Italian front and it is now time for you to counter the upcoming Allied invasion of France.
column2: 我们对你在意大利战线的表现十分满意，现在该由你应对盟军即将发起的法国登陆了。

column1: We have given you the key role in the invasion of France. You are to annihilate the French, British and Belgian armies located west and north of the Ardennes. In order to ensure their destruction, the early capture of Paris, and the opportunity to invade England this summer,  you must advance to the English Channel and capture all of the objectives no later than June 8th. A swift blow, delivered to the Allied armies as soon as possible, is essential to allow us time for an invasion of England this year.
column2: 我们已把入侵法国的关键任务交给你。你要歼灭驻于阿登以西和以北的法国、英国和比利时军队。为确保将其歼灭、早日夺取巴黎，并获得今夏入侵英国的机会，你必须在6月8日之前推进至英吉利海峡并夺取所有目标。尽快对盟军部队施以迅猛一击，对我们争取时间、在今年内入侵英国至关重要。

column1: We have just one step left to kick out the Americans from the east coast, start to move !
column2: 把美国人赶出东海岸只差最后一步，开始行动！

column1: We have lost the initiative on the eastern front.  Another year of senseless fighting in Russia has come and gone..
column2: 我们在东线失去了先手。俄国战场上又一年无谓的厮杀就此过去。

column1: We have moved your troops into Hungary and it is time for you to lead Operation Waldteufel, the attack to retake Budapest. You must take all of your objectives by March 25th at the latest. However, an earlier completion of your mission is necessary if we are to continue the counteroffensive and drive the Soviets back to Russia.
column2: 我们已将你的部队调入匈牙利，现在该由你指挥「森林魔鬼」行动（Operation Waldteufel），即夺回布达佩斯的进攻。你最迟必须在 3月25日前夺取全部目标。但若我们要继续反攻、把苏联人赶回俄国，就必须更早完成任务。

column1: We have reached a critical juncture in our war in Russia. Many generals believe that we should divert your forces to assist Army Group South in its drive to capture Kiev. There does appear to be an opportunity to trap and destroy a large part of the Soviet Army in this area. Other generals believe we should ignore the south and instead send your forces driving directly toward Moscow as soon as supplies can be brought forward, in order to reach there before winter. They believe a move toward Kiev will delay the drive on Moscow and may cause us to fail at the city gates. It appears that high command is leaning toward a drive on Kiev. Your opinion on this matter could sway their decision toward Moscow, but it would surely cost you some of your prestige to voice your opinion regarding such a key decision.
column2: 我们在俄国的战争已到关键时刻。许多将领认为，我们应把你这支部队转用于协助南方集团军群攻取基辅。这一地区看来确实有机会围歼苏军的大部兵力。另一些将领则认为，我们应放弃南线，一俟补给前送就令你的部队直取莫斯科，以求在冬季到来前抵达该城。他们认为转向基辅会迟滞对莫斯科的进攻，可能使我军功败垂成于城下。目前看来，最高统帅部倾向于进攻基辅。你对这一问题的看法可能使他们的决定转向莫斯科，但就如此关键的决策发表意见，必定会使你损失一部分声望。

column1: We now expect the Americans and British to launch an attack on Sicily and Southern Italy. At a minimum, you must put up a stubborn defense and hold at least three objectives until after September 8th. Ideally, you will hold at least ten objectives. Good luck, you will need it.
column2: 我们现在预计美英联军将对西西里和意大利南部发起进攻。你至少要顽强防守，将不少于三个目标坚守到9月8日之后。最理想的情况是守住至少十个目标。祝你好运，你会需要它的。

column1: We were disappointed with your poor results in Normandy,  however, due to your previous successes, we have decided to allow you to honorably retire from service.
column2: 你在诺曼底战绩不佳，令我们失望；但鉴于你此前的战功，我们决定允许你体面地退出现役。

column1: We were disappointed with your poor results in Normandy. Your performance must improve or the war will soon be lost.
column2: 你在诺曼底战绩不佳，令我们失望。你的表现必须有所改观，否则战争很快就要失败。

column1: We were pleased with your initial success in driving deep into Russia.
column2: 你初期深入俄国的战果令我们满意。

column1: We were very disappointed by your inability to take Cairo. This has given the Americans the perfect opportunity to invade Northwest Africa. You are being re-assigned.
column2: 你未能夺取开罗，令我们极为失望。这给了美国人入侵西北非的绝佳机会。你将被调任他职。

column1: We were very disappointed that you were unable to complete your mission on Crete successfully. You are to report back to Berlin for re-assignment.
column2: 你未能成功完成克里特岛上的任务，我们极为失望。着你回柏林报到，另行分配职务。

column1: We were very disappointed with your inability to stop their forces, and unfortuately, they continue to push us back and threaten our very existence.  You have been relieved of duty.
column2: 你无力阻止敌军，令我们极为失望；不幸的是，他们继续把我们逼退，威胁到我们的生存。你已被解除职务。

column1: We were very disappointed with your performance in Yugoslavia and Greece. It is time for you to prove that you are worthy to be a Panzer General.
column2: 你在南斯拉夫与希腊的表现令我们非常失望。现在该由你证明自己配得上装甲元帅这一称号。

column1: We've restored all colonies of our ally and we control the whole Red Sea, but we have to gain another strong point controlled by the British:- Mombasa.
column2: 我们已恢复了盟友的全部殖民地，并控制了整个红海，但我们必须再夺取一个由英国人控制的据点：蒙巴萨。

column1: Well done General! You captured your objectives quickly. Our advance into southern Russia and the Ukraine is going as planned. We can now help our Romanian allies deal with the Soviet occupation force in Moldavia.  The General staff has decided that you will lead the drive to capture Kishinev.
column2: 干得好，将军！您迅速夺取了目标。我们向南俄和乌克兰的推进正按计划进行。现在我们能够帮助罗马尼亚盟友对付苏联在摩尔达维亚的占领军了。总参谋部已决定由您率部夺取基什尼奥夫。

column1: Well done!  You gave the Reds got a good licking at Guipuzcoa.  Now they will be unable to receive more supplies or weapons from France.  It's only a matter of time until the north is in our hands.  I'm sorry but you are not going to have time to enjoy the summer in San Sebastian.  I have another important task for you and it must be done quickly!
column2: 干得好！你在吉普斯夸狠狠教训了赤色分子。现在他们再也无法从法国获得补给或武器了。北方落入我们手中只是时间问题。很抱歉，你没时间在圣塞瓦斯蒂安享受夏天了。我另有一项重要任务交给你，必须尽快完成！

column1: Well done!, The British have fought hard to kick us out from Fort Capuzzo, but it's still in our hands.
column2: 干得好！英军拼命想把我们赶出卡普佐堡，但堡垒仍在我们手中。

column1: Well done. We have recaptured the important port of Benghazi, and now, onwards to Tobruk!.
column2: 干得好。我们夺回了重要的班加西港，现在，向托布鲁克前进！

column1: Well,  Herr General, a bold stroke from the city of Klin to Fedoroloka will close the ring on Moscow. If we can drive through to this point, the enemy capital will surely be ours.  Good luck!
column2: 将军阁下，由克林向费多罗夫卡发起一次大胆突击，即可合拢对莫斯科的包围。若能推进至此，敌国首都必归我有。祝您好运！

column1: Well, following your success at Sedan, your brave men must now capture the port of Dunkirk on the Channel.  Allied forces in Belgium will be trapped if we can secure this harbor.  With the British Army as prisoners, we can dictate peace on our terms.  Of course, the English are aware of this possibility and will fight  furiously to protect their lines of retreat.  Good luck to you.
column2: 好，继色当的胜利之后，你的勇士们现在必须夺取英吉利海峡上的敦刻尔克港。如果我们能拿下这个港口，在比利时的盟军部队就将陷入包围。把英国军队变成俘虏，我们就能按我们的条件决定和平。当然，英国人明白这种可能，他们会拼死保卫自己的撤退路线。祝你好运。

column1: Well, our forces have stormed ashore on England's beaches only to meet ferocious resistance.  Our drive to capture London has been stalled.  Now, your services are needed to capture Windsor, a vital communications center.  With this rail junction in our hands, London will be cut off from their industrial centers and be forced to surrender.  Good luck, Herr Feldmarschall.
column2: 我们的部队已冲上英格兰海滩，却遭遇了凶猛抵抗。我们夺取伦敦的推进已经停滞。现在需要您出力夺取温莎——一处至关重要的通信中心。只要这个铁路枢纽落入我们手中，伦敦就将与其工业中心被切断联系，被迫投降。祝您好运，元帅阁下。

column1: With the prestige you've gained, you can now equip your new units and make upgrades.
column2: 凭借您所获得的声望，现在可以装备新部队并进行升级了。

column1: You couldn't force the Allies back into Tunisia, so it's impossible for us to attack with the few units we have.
column2: 您未能迫使盟军退回突尼斯，因此凭我们现有的少量部队不可能发起进攻。

column1: You couldn't force the Allies back into Tunisia, so it's impossible to attack with the few units we have.
column2: 您未能迫使盟军退回突尼斯，因此凭我们现有的少量部队不可能发起进攻。

column1: You couldn't force the Allies back into Tunisia, so it's impossible to defend Alexandria and Tunisia with the few units we have.
column2: 您未能迫使盟军退回突尼斯，因此凭我们现有的少量部队不可能守住亚历山大和突尼斯。

column1: You have chosen to play the Greater Europe campaign path!
column2: 您已选择游玩大欧洲战役路线！

column1: You have chosen to play the traditional Blitzkrieg! campaign path!
column2: 您已选择游玩传统闪电战战役路线！

column1: You have dealt the Red Army a severe blow. With our line shortened, we will be able to transfer some troops to Feldmarschall von Paulus at Stalingrad. Good work, Herr General.  Meanwhile the Finns are opening a drive to recover the land they lost to the Bolsheviks in 1940.  Remembering your help in 1939 the Finns have specifically asked for you to lead their drive.  The General Staff has agreed to their request, so you and your men are to transfer North after a short period for rest and refitting.
column2: 您给了红军沉重一击。随着我们的战线缩短，我们将能把部分部队转交给斯大林格勒的冯·保卢斯元帅。干得好，将军阁下。与此同时，芬兰人正发起攻势，要夺回他们1940年失去给布尔什维克的土地。鉴于您1939年的援助，芬兰人特意请求由您来指挥他们的攻势。总参谋部已同意他们的请求，因此您和您的部下将在短暂休整和补充装备后调往北方。

column1: You have done very well on the Italian front.
column2: 你在意大利战线的表现非常出色。

column1: You have failed to make Allies to retreat in Tunisia, so it's impossible to defend Alexandria and Tunisia with the few units we have.
column2: 你未能迫使盟军在突尼斯撤退，因此仅凭我们手中这点部队，既守不住亚历山大，也守不住突尼斯。

column1: You have passed this first trial, now we are going to Massawa's Port to cut off any supply entry from the Indian Ocean.
column2: 您已通过了第一次考验，现在我们前往马萨瓦港，以切断来自印度洋的一切补给输入。

column1: You have selected the path to ensure the oil routes going through Syria, Iraq and Persia.
column2: 您已选择了确保经由叙利亚、伊拉克和波斯的石油路线这条路线。

column1: You haven't chosen a path, please try it again.
column2: 您尚未选择一条路线，请重试。

column1: You must complete the upcoming campaign by November 26th at the latest. The fate of the war in the east is in your hands.
column2: 你必须在11月26日之前完成即将展开的战役。东线战事的命运掌握在你手中。

column1: You must help defend Tunisia so that we can maintain a position in North West Africa. If you can hold Tunis and at least two other objectives until well into March, will almost certainly cause a delay in future Allied operations.
column2: 你必须协助防守突尼斯，以便我们在西北非保持一个立足点。如果你能守住突尼斯城以及至少另外两个目标直到3月过半，几乎肯定会使盟军日后的行动受到拖延。

column1: You must take your objectives by no later than November 16th, but in order for us to ensure that we can hold Moscow in the face of a determined counterattack, you should strive to take Moscow several weeks earlier. This will no doubt be our best chance to win the War in the East.
column2: 你必须在11月16日之前夺取全部目标，但为确保我军能在敌军坚决反攻之下守住莫斯科，你应争取提前数周拿下莫斯科。这无疑将是我们赢得东线战争的最佳机会。

column1: You put up a good fight in Normandy.
column2: 你在诺曼底打得很顽强。

column1: You've failed and your casualities have been huge, the Americans have triumphed in El Guettar.
column2: 您失败了，伤亡惨重，美国人在盖塔尔取胜。

column1: You've selected the path towards South Afrika, now you have to recapture the Italian Colonies.
column2: 您已选择了通往南非的路线，现在必须夺回意大利殖民地。

column1: Your assault on Yugoslavia and Greece was blitzkrieg in its most powerful sense. Due to your spectacular success, we have decided to appoint you to command a very special operation.
column2: 你对南斯拉夫与希腊的进攻是闪击战最有力的体现。鉴于你取得的辉煌战果，我们决定委任你指挥一次极为特殊的行动。

column1: Your attack on the Ardennes was a dismal failure. Not only did it fall far short of its ultimate goal of forcing the Allies to sue for peace, but the resources we wasted will no longer be available for the defense of the homeland.
column2: 你对阿登的进攻是一次惨败。它不仅远未达成迫使盟军求和这一最终目标，而且我们为此浪费的资源再也无法用于本土防御。

column1: Your attack was quite an achievement considering the odds against you; unfortunately, it fell short of its ultimate aim of forcing the Allies to sue for peace.
column2: 考虑到敌我力量悬殊，你的进攻已是相当可观的战果；遗憾的是，它未能达成迫使盟军求和的最终目标。

column1: Your attack was swift and decisive, worthy of being written into the history in the true samurai tradition.
column2: 您的进攻迅速而果断，堪称武士道传统，足以载入史册。

column1: Your blitzkrieg through Belgium was most impressive and has given us a great opportunity to conquer France in time for an assault on England this year.
column2: 你在比利时的闪击战极为出色，为我们及时征服法国、以便在今年进攻英国提供了绝佳机会。

column1: Your capture of Sevastopol on schedule deserves praise for a job well done.
column2: 你按期攻克塞瓦斯托波尔，任务完成出色，值得嘉奖。

column1: Your capture of Washington has allowed us to negotiate a favorable peace treaty with the Americans. But, their ability to create and test an atomic bomb has kept us from uniting North America and Europe. Your brilliant leadership throughout this war will long be remembered in the coming years of peace.
column2: 你攻占华盛顿，使我们得以与美国人谈判达成一项有利的和约。但是，他们制造并试爆原子弹的能力，使我们未能把北美与欧洲统一起来。你在这场战争全程中展现的卓越指挥，将在未来的和平岁月里长久为人们所铭记。

column1: Your defeat has allowed the Russians to continue their advance threatening our very existence.  Your services are no longer needed.
column2: 你的失败使苏军得以继续推进，威胁到我们的生存。你的职务已不再需要。

column1: Your defense of France was adequate; unfortunately, the Allies have broken out of Normandy and are advancing across France.
column2: 你对法国的防御尚属合格；遗憾的是，盟军已突穿诺曼底，正横越法国推进。

column1: Your defense of France was disappointing and has allowed the Allies to race across the countryside. Your leadership must soon improve.
column2: 你在法国的防御令人失望，使盟军得以在乡野间长驱直入。你的指挥很快必须有所改观。

column1: Your defense of France was disappointing, however, due to your previous successes, we have decided to allow you to honorably retire from service.
column2: 你在法国的防御令人失望，但鉴于你此前的战功，我们决定允许你体面地退出现役。

column1: Your defense of Normandy was outstanding.
column2: 你对诺曼底的防御表现出色。

column1: Your defense of the Italian mainland was satisfactory. To date, you have done a reasonable job defending Southern Italy, but unfortunately, the Allies have been able to fight their way onto the Italian mainland.
column2: 你对意大利本土的防御尚称合格。迄今为止，你对意大利南部的防守还算可以，但遗憾的是，盟军还是杀上了意大利本土。

column1: Your early capture of Washington has forced the surrender of the United States before they could successfully test an atomic bomb. North America and Europe have been successfully united under common leadership and all the other nations of the world are courting German favor. The world is at peace.Your brilliant leadership throughout this war ranks you among the greatest generals that have ever lived, and you will be remembered as the greatest Panzer General in history.
column2: 你提前攻占华盛顿，迫使美国在其成功试爆原子弹之前投降。北美与欧洲已在共同领导之下成功统一，世界其余各国纷纷向德国示好。世界恢复了和平。你在这场战争全程中展现的卓越指挥，使你跻身有史以来最伟大的将领之列，人们将铭记你是历史上最伟大的装甲元帅。

column1: Your efforts have been very meritorious, but the Americans have broken the line in El Guettar, so we don't have another choice:- Retreat!
column2: 您的努力非常值得称道，但美国人在盖塔尔突破了防线，我们别无选择：撤退！

column1: Your failure in the Caucasus has put us in an extremely difficult position. The Soviet winter offensives have forced us back all along the front. You are being re-assigned.
column2: 你在高加索的失败使我们陷入极其困难的处境。苏军的冬季攻势已迫使我们在全线后退。你将被调任他职。

column1: Your failure in the invasion on Malta will drive you to a most historic path in the Alamein sector, where prestige will be lacking.
column2: 您在马耳他登陆的失败将把您引向阿拉曼地区最具历史意义的一条道路，在那里声望将会匮乏。

column1: Your failure in the Middle East has cost us dearly. British counterattacks have forced us to abandon Egypt, therefore we have no choice but to dismiss you.
column2: 你在中东的失败让我们付出了惨重代价。英军反攻迫使我们放弃埃及，因此我们别无选择，只能解除你的职务。

column1: Your first mission in Operation Fall Weiss, the conquest of Poland, is to capture the key cities of Kutno and Lodz by September 10th. This keeps open the possibility of conquering Poland before the French and British can launch an attack on Germany. If these objectives are taken before September 10th, additional forces may be available to you for the assault on Warsaw.
column2: 你在征服波兰的白色方案行动中的首个任务，是在9月10日前夺取库特诺与罗兹这两座重要城市。这使我们在法国与英国对德国发动进攻之前征服波兰的可能性依然存在。若能在9月10日前夺取这些目标，可能会有更多部队可供你用于进攻华沙。

column1: Your great success in Africa has not gone unnoticed by the high command, but unfortunately,we must now move some of our assets in order to strengthen our hold on Northwest Africa.
column2: 你在非洲的重大胜利已引起最高统帅部的注意，但遗憾的是，我们现在必须抽调部分兵力，以加强我们对西北非的控制。

column1: Your great triumph in the Middle East has been acclaimed by all Germany.  We are planning a major offensive against Russia in the Caucasus early this summer. Our control of the Middle East will allow us to attack the Caucasus from both west and south.
column2: 你在中东的重大胜利赢得了全德国的赞誉。我们计划今年初夏在高加索方向对俄国发动一场大规模攻势。控制中东将使我们可以从西面和南面两个方向进攻高加索。

column1: Your great victory is reminiscent of your early blitzkriegs through Europe. We have forced the Soviets to make a separate peace with favorable terms. We must now focus our resources on fighting off the American and British armies.
column2: 你的伟大胜利令人想起你早年的欧洲闪击战。我们已迫使苏联以有利条件单独媾和。现在我们必须集中资源抗击美英军队。

column1: Your inability to capture your objectives in and around Moscow has led to disaster. The Soviet armies, reinforced by troops from Siberia, have wreaked havoc on our overextended and once-invincible armies. Fierce Soviet counterattacks this winter have pushed back our weary troops all along the front, you are dismissed.
column2: 你未能夺取莫斯科及其周边的目标，已导致灾难性后果。得到西伯利亚部队增援的苏军，对我军战线过长、曾号称无敌的军团造成了毁灭性打击。今冬苏军的猛烈反攻，已将我疲惫的部队全线击退。你被解职了。

column1: Your inability to defend Germany has led to our total destruction. Although you fought well in many battles, we have, in the end, lost everything.
column2: 你无力保卫德国，导致我们彻底毁灭。尽管你在许多战斗中打得很好，我们最终还是失去了一切。
