column1: Your leadership proved weak and uninspiring at Kharkov, and we were unable to regain the initiative. Another year of senseless fighting in Russia has come and gone.
column2: 你的指挥在哈尔科夫表现得软弱乏力、毫无锐气，我们未能重夺先手。俄国战场上又一年无谓的厮杀就此过去。

column1: Your next assignment is to take Warsaw and several nearby Polish cities by no later than September 30th. Intelligence warns us that the French and British are preparing for an attack towards the Rhine within 2-3 weeks, so it is important to take all of your objectives as soon as possible.
column2: 你的下一个任务是夺取华沙以及附近数座波兰城市，期限不得晚于9月30日。情报部门警告我们，法国和英国正准备在2至3周内向莱茵河方向发动进攻，因此尽快夺取全部目标至关重要。

column1: Your next mission is to defeat the Yugoslav and Greek armies and force the British forever from the European mainland. You should capture your objectives by April 30th so that our upcoming invasion of Russia is not delayed. If you are able to complete your mission earlier, we may honor you with the command of our planned airborne assault on Crete.
column2: 你的下一项任务是击败南斯拉夫与希腊军队，把英国人永远逐出欧洲大陆。你应在 4月30日前夺取各项目标，以免我们即将发动的对俄进攻被拖延。若能提前完成任务，我们或将委你指挥计划中的克里特空降突击，以为嘉奖。

column1: Your next mission is to invade England. You must seize London and all other objectives in England before our limited shipping and the storms in the English Channel force us to withdraw our invasion forces. High command has given you until September 30th to complete your mission, but we fear that you must succeed sooner or we will see the invasion falter before the British surrender. Operation Sealion is about to begin. Good Luck!
column2: 你的下一个任务是入侵英国。你必须在我们的有限海运能力与英吉利海峡的风暴迫使我们撤回入侵部队之前，夺取伦敦以及英格兰境内的所有其他目标。最高统帅部给了你到9月30日的时间完成任务，但我们担心你必须更早取胜，否则入侵行动会在英国投降之前便难以为继。海狮行动即将开始。祝你好运！

column1: Your outstanding victory near Warsaw defending against the Soviet juggernaut has helped us keep the Soviets at bay for another year.
column2: 你在华沙附近抗击苏联庞然大物的卓越胜利，帮助我们又把苏联人挡住了一年。

column1: Your performance in Holland was quite disappointing and because of it, we have lost any ability to counterattack before the enemy's final assault on Germany.
column2: 你在荷兰的表现相当令人失望，正因如此，在敌军对德国发动最后攻势之前，我们已丧失了任何反攻能力。

column1: Your performance in Holland was very good, but unfortunately,  we have still lost any ability to counterattack before the enemy's final assault on Germany.
column2: 你在荷兰的表现非常出色，但遗憾的是，在敌军对德国发动最后攻势之前，我们仍然丧失了任何反攻能力。

column1: Your recent performance has been superb; unfortunately, the Western Allies' overwhelming quantitative superiority has allowed them to force us back to our borders. Your most recent victory in Southern France combined with your earlier victory in Normandy have proven to us that you have the ability to lead our upcoming counterattack in the Ardennes.
column2: 你近期的表现极为出色；遗憾的是，西线盟军压倒性的数量优势已将我们逼回本土边界。你最近在法国南部的胜利，加上此前在诺曼底的胜利，已向我们证明你有能力指挥我们即将在阿登地区发起的反攻。

column1: Your smashing success in overrunning the Russian frontier armies and taking Smolensk proves that yet again that you are the premier Panzer General in the world.
column2: 你碾压俄国边境各集团军并夺取斯摩棱斯克的辉煌胜利，再次证明你是世界上最杰出的装甲元帅。

column1: Your solid performance near Warsaw against the Soviet juggernaut has helped us keep the Russians at bay for another year.
column2: 你在华沙附近抗击苏联庞然大物的稳健表现，帮助我们又把苏军挡住了一年。

column1: Your storming of Sevastopol will be recognized as one of history's greatest assaults against a fortress.
column2: 你对塞瓦斯托波尔的强攻，将被公认为历史上最伟大的要塞攻坚作战之一。

column1: Your success holding back the Allied invasion force was an inspiration to the Wehrmacht. Unfortunately, we were unable to stop their final reoccupation of Africa.
column2: 你成功遏止盟军入侵部队，令国防军深受鼓舞。遗憾的是，我们未能阻止他们最终重新占领非洲。

column1: Your success in phase one of the attack on Poland was outstanding. Due to your rapid advance, their defenses have been thrown into disarray, leaving the road to Warsaw wide open.
column2: 你在进攻波兰第一阶段的表现极为出色。由于你推进迅速，敌军防御已陷入混乱，通往华沙的道路已完全敞开。

column1: Your success in Poland has impressed the General Staff.
column2: 你在波兰的胜利给总参谋部留下了深刻印象。

column1: Your success last summer in slowing the Allied breakout from Normandy has convinced us that you are the most qualified general to lead our upcoming counterattack in the Ardennes.
column2: 你去年夏天成功迟滞了盟军自诺曼底的突破，这使我们确信，你是率领我们即将在阿登发起反攻的最合适将领。

column1: Your success to date has been noteworthy. Our control of the Middle East will allow us to attack the Caucasus from both west and south.
column2: 你迄今取得的成功值得称道。控制中东将使我们可以从西面和南面两个方向进攻高加索。

column1: Your successful assault on Yugoslavia and Greece will allow us to begin an invasion of Russia without fearing an attack on our flank from the Balkans.
column2: 你对南斯拉夫与希腊的成功进攻，使我们得以在不必担心巴尔干方向侧翼受攻击的情况下发动对俄进攻。

column1: Your successful capture of Moscow turned out to be short-lived. Soviet reinforcements from Siberia were able to push back our weary troops. Fierce Soviet counterattacks have weakened our once invincible-armies.
column2: 你成功攻占莫斯科的战果未能持久。来自西伯利亚的苏军增援击退了我军疲惫的部队。苏军的猛烈反攻削弱了我军昔日无敌的军团。

column1: Your successful conclusion of the battle for Kiev has been noted.
column2: 你成功结束基辅战役一事已记录在案。

column1: Your successful delaying action in Africa was helpful in slowing the Allies. Unfortunately, we were unable to stop their final reoccupation.
column2: 你在非洲卓有成效的迟滞作战有助于延缓盟军的推进。遗憾的是，我们未能阻止他们最终的重新占领。

column1: Your troops, now located in the Arnhem sector of Holland,  are fighting off a massive Allied attack aimed at securing a path across the many rivers and canals leading to the vital crossing of the Rhine at Arnhem. It is essential that you prevent the Allies from completing their plans. If the Allies secure Arnhem, they will be able to force their way into Germany this year before we can mount a strong counterattack.
column2: 你的部队目前位于荷兰阿纳姆地区，正在抗击盟军的大规模进攻。盟军此举意在打通一条穿越众多河流与运河的通路，以夺取阿纳姆的莱茵河关键渡口。你务必阻止盟军完成其计划。一旦盟军拿下阿纳姆，他们就能在我们组织起强大反攻之前，于今年突入德国境内。

column1: Your victory at Kharkov has allowed us to regain the initiative. We must continue to press our attacks against the Soviets.
column2: 你在哈尔科夫的胜利使我们重夺先手。我们必须继续对苏军施加攻势。

column1: Your victory at Kharkov was so quick and decisive that the Soviet forces became hopelessly disorganized. We have been able to keep them on the run ever since.
column2: 你在哈尔科夫的胜利如此迅速而果断，致使苏军陷入无可挽回的混乱。此后我们一直让他们疲于奔命。

column1: Your victory has helped delay the Russian advance, but it was insufficient to keep them from continuing their attacks.
column2: 你的胜利有助于迟滞苏军的推进，但不足以阻止他们继续进攻。

column1: Your victory on Crete adds yet another successful campaign to your resume. Your next assignment will be critical to your career and to the cause of the war.
column2: 你在克里特的胜利为你的履历再添一次成功的战役。你的下一项任务对你的前程和战争大局都至关重要。

column1: Your victory on Crete will go down in history as a military masterpiece. Your reputation within the army is unequaled. It is for this reason that we have given the key role in the invasion of Russia and the extra resources merited by your prestige.
column2: 你在克里特的胜利将作为军事杰作载入史册。你在军中的声望无人能及。正因如此，我们把入侵俄国的关键任务以及与你声望相称的额外资源交给了你。
「阳台」的中央集团军群(Army Group Center)。
